Equipped with a beam shot rifle, beam saber, beam tomahawk (one each in expanded and stowed form), a seal, and six funnels. The fingers are movable. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, and the waist can be rotated. The elbows are double jointed and the knees are triple jointed, allowing you to easily recreate action poses from the movie. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts. The Heat Shotel can be expanded and stored without replacing it, and can also be mounted on a backpack. Comes with a non-woven cloak and optional armor for attaching a mount. Comes with a 1/20 Scale Quatre La Barba Winner figure.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」の主人公ヒイロ・ユイが搭乗するウイングガンダムが1/144スケールモデルで登場。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを採用し、可動範囲を広めています。また胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転も可能です。腰アーマーの、フロント部とサイド部が可動します。背部ウイングの左右スイングと、展開が可能です。ヒザは三重関節になっています。武器はシールドとバスターライフル、ビームサーベルが付いています。手首を取り外してバード形態への変形が可能です。オープニングに登場する時のポーズを再現したヒイロのフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: The Wing Gundam piloted by Heero Yuy, the main character of "Mobile Suit Gundam W", is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to widen the range of motion. Also, the chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, and the hips can be rotated. The front and side parts of the waist armor are movable. It is possible to swing the back wing left and right and deploy it. The knees are triple jointed. Weapons include a seal, a buster rifle, and a beam saber. It is possible to transform into bird form by removing the wrists. Comes with a Heero figure that recreates the pose he appears in in the opening.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW」物語中盤、一度撃破され月面基地で5博士による強化改造を受け、甦ったガンダムデスサイズヘルを1/100スケールでリアルに再現しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰のひねりを実現しました。指も独立して可動します。強化後、追加されたアクティブクロークの展開機構は、差し替えなしで劇中のアクションを再現できます。ひじ、ひざは二重関節になっており、広範囲な可動を再現しています。ツインビームサイズの2本の刃はそれぞれ独立して可動します。収納状態の柄は腰リアアーマーの専用ラックに装着できます。棺の形を模した新型バスターシールドは、先端部の刃は開閉可能です。更にビームパーツの着脱もできます。
phrases.en: In the middle of the story of "Mobile Suit Gundam W", the Gundam Death Scythe Hell, which was once destroyed and then strengthened and modified by Dr. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, and the waist can be twisted. The fingers can also move independently. After strengthening, the added active cloak deployment mechanism can reproduce the actions in the play without replacing it. The elbows and knees are double jointed, allowing for a wide range of movement. The two twin beam size blades move independently. The handle in the stored state can be attached to the special rack on the rear waist armor. The new Buster Seal is modeled after the shape of a coffin, and the blade at the tip can be opened and closed. Furthermore, the beam parts can be attached and detached.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム MS IGLOO」に登場するボールをイメージしたシャークマウス仕様の「ボール」をMGで再現。特徴的なマーキングは水転写デカールで再現。作業用ポッドとしてのリアル感の追求のため、各部のディテールをより精密に再現。作業アーム部には金属シャフトを、可動アーム基部の関節カバーなどには軟質パーツを利用し、リアルな質感を再現。精密度を演出するため、アーム先端には極細リード線を使用。展示用台座も同梱しています。
phrases.en: A shark mouse-style "ball" inspired by the ball that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam MS IGLOO" is reproduced in MG. Characteristic markings are reproduced with water transfer decals. In order to pursue a realistic feel as a work pod, the details of each part are reproduced more precisely. A metal shaft is used for the working arm, and soft parts are used for the joint cover at the base of the movable arm to reproduce a realistic texture. In order to create precision, an ultra-thin lead wire is used at the tip of the arm. A display pedestal is also included.

phrases.ja: TVアニメ「機動戦士ガンダム SEED」に登場する主役機「ストライクガンダム」と、3種類のストライカーパックがセットになってビックサイズ1/60スケールで立体化しました。 パーツ別に色分けされた精密な外観ディテールを再現。両手首の指は全て可動式で、ビックスケールならではのアクションが楽しめます。 コクピットハッチは開閉式で、内部にはパイロットの「キラ・ヤマト」のフィギュアを再現しています。 肩の付け根関節の可動、足首の二重関節可動などにより、劇中のアクションを楽しめます。 両腰アーマーに収納した、折り畳み式コンバットナイフ「アーマーシュナイダー」を取り出せます。 武器はビームライフル、2パターンの装着が可能なシールド、コンバットナイフ2本に加え、ストライクガンダムの背部へ着脱可能なエール、ソード、ランチャーのストライカーパックが付いています。
phrases.en: The main character "Strike Gundam" that appears in the TV anime "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" and three types of Striker packs are set and made into a big size 1/60 Scale. Reproduces precise exterior details that are color-coded by part. The fingers on both wrists are all movable, allowing you to enjoy the action unique to Big Scale. The cockpit hatch can be opened and closed, and a figure of the pilot "Kira Yamato" is reproduced inside. Enjoy the action in the play with movable shoulder joints and double joints at the ankles. Take out the folding combat knife "Armor Schneider" stored in the armor on both hips. Weapons include a beam rifle, a Seal that can be attached in two patterns, and two combat knives, as well as a striker pack of ale, sword, and launcher that can be attached to the back of Strike Gundam.

(Since the weapon can be attached to the HP of the overhang cannon, the core booster can be made into a heavy weapon) ■Added the option of a blue leg cover for the ending specification VGundam hexa. *Special joint parts are included for interlocking the action base. (For MS, 5 total for each flight mode) Molded product x 24, Foil Seal x 2, Marking Seal x 2, Tetron Seal x 2, Assembly Manual x 2

phrases.ja: ●　イフリート・ナハトの機体形状を、各所新規造形で再現！　　胸部、肩部、腕部、腰部、脚部、バックパックなど全身各部に新規造形を加えて、イフリート・ナハトの機体形状を再現。　　肩部　　鋭角化された肩部アーマー、側面装甲は新規造形。　　胸部　　熱探知対策のために、排熱口やスラスターに弁を設けた、胴体部は新規造形パーツ。　　腕部　　籠手のような増加装甲を新規パーツで用意。　　左腕部装甲内には、内蔵式三連装ガトリングガンを装備。パーツの差し替えにより開閉を再現可能。　　バックパック　　スラスターノズルと廃熱ガードの形状など、特徴的なバックパックを新規造形で再現。　　コールド・ブレードの鞘をマウント可能。　　腰部スカート　　特徴的なスタイリングのフロントスカートやリアスカート、バックスラスターなどを新規パーツで再現。
phrases.en: ● Ifrit Nacht's aircraft shape is reproduced with new modeling in various parts! New modeling has been added to each part of the body including the chest, shoulders, arms, waist, legs, and backpack to recreate Ifrit Nacht's body shape. Shoulders The sharpened shoulder armor and side armor are newly designed. Chest: The torso is a newly molded part, with valves installed in the heat exhaust vent and thruster to prevent heat detection. Arms Additional armor like gauntlets is available as new parts. The left arm armor is equipped with a built-in triple gatling gun. Opening and closing can be reproduced by replacing parts. Backpack The distinctive backpack, such as the shape of the thruster nozzle and waste heat guard, is reproduced with new modeling. Cold Blade scabbard can be mounted. Waist Skirt The distinctive styling of the front skirt, rear skirt, back thruster, etc. is reproduced with new parts.

The rocket bazooka can slide back and forth and can be mounted on a backpack. The mono-eye panel is molded as a separate part. It comes with a heat saber. Comes with a replacement flat.

The "M9009B compound bayonet-equipped beam rifle" on both hips can deploy bayonets, and a twin rifle combining the left and right rifles can also be reproduced. A special stand is included for greater freedom of posing.

It is possible to reproduce the wearing of armor from "light armor form" to "warrior form". . Attack mode "Crash Vice Mode" can be reproduced by combining armor and weapons. It can also be transformed into a "tool box" form. Weapons include a sword, hammer, and pliers.

phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Shenron Gundam, which was once captured by OZ, has been powered up by Dr. 5, and Altron Gundam is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The front chest armor and torso are separate parts, and the waist can rotate, and the front and side parts of the waist armor can be moved. You can reproduce the dragon hang development of both arms without replacing the wrists. In the dragon hang, the lower jaw opens and closes. The random binder on the back reproduces the deployment of the beam cannon and the left and right deployment of the wings. The twin beam trident can be attached to and detached from the left random binder by removing the beam part. Includes a figure of Zhang Wufei wearing the Chinese clothes he wore in the movie.

phrases.ja: TV「機動新世紀ガンダムX」に登場、バリエーション性の高い合体機構を見せた機体をキット化しました。A（飛行ユニット）およびB（コンテナ）各パーツの分離合体・変形機構を再現し、ガンダムダブルエックス、ガンダムエアマスターバースト、ガンダムレオパルドDとの合体がそれぞれ可能になっています。ジーファルコン合体時に、ツインサテライトキャノンの発射形態が再現可能です。ジーファルコンの武器の赤外線ホーミングミサイルは開閉機構が再現できます。Bパーツコンテナはミサイルブロックの開閉や、モビルスーツ収納用ハッチの開閉ギミックが再現できます。エネルギーパックのスイング機構により、両翼の拡散ビーム砲が可動します。ダブルエックスのサイドアーマーへマウント可能なビーム・サーベル、ダブエックス専用バスター・ライフル、マスターバーストがついています。アンテナなどにメッキパーツを使用しています。ホイルシール付です。
phrases.en: The aircraft that appeared on the TV "Mobile New Century GundamX" and showed a highly variable combination mechanism has been made into a kit. The separation and combination/transformation mechanism of each part of A (flight unit) and B (container) is reproduced, and it is possible to combine with Gundam Double X, Gundam Air Master Burst, and Gundam Leopard D. When G-Falcon is combined, the firing form of the twin satellite cannons can be reproduced. The opening and closing mechanism of G-Falcon's weapon's infrared homing missile can be reproduced. The B parts container can reproduce the opening/closing gimmick of the missile block and the opening/closing hatch for storing mobile suits. The swing mechanism of the energy pack allows the diffuse beam cannons on both wings to move. Includes a beam saber that can be mounted on Double X's side armor, a Dove X exclusive buster rifle, and a master burst. Plated parts are used for the antenna etc. Comes with foil seal.

A new gimmick built into the hip joint and side armor allows you to recreate the "kick" of swinging the leg sideways. Beam effects can be attached to the legs and wings. Features: The wings on the back "Fatum-01" expand in conjunction with the side slide of the engine block. Weapons include a beam rifle, connectable beam saber x 2, and a beam carry seal. The beam carry seal is made of a transparent material and can be attached and removed, the grapple stinger's injection gimmick is reproduced with a wire lead wire, and the detachable large beam boomerang can be equipped as a large beam sword with the movable beam base.A special action base joint that can be attached to the lifter and a 1/100 Scale "Athrun Zara" (standing and seated) figure are included.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム0083」に登場する「ジム改」のプラモデル。オーストラリアのトリントン基地に配備されていた、改修されたジムをマスターグレードの精巧なディティールでキット化しました。足部には内部フレームを再現。ヒザの裏を通る動力パイプにはメッシュパイプを用いるなど、細部にまでこだわり再現されています。胴体内部には、緻密なメカニクスを再現されたコクピットブロックが収納可能です。マーキングシールやガンダムデカールなどを使用する事で、洗練されたディティールの機体を再現できます。武器の90mmマシンガンは、基部以外を組み替える事で、ジムライフルを再現できます。それ以外にも、ビームスプレーガン、ビームサーベルが２本、裏に収納できるシールドが付いています。
phrases.en: A plastic model of "Gym Kai" that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083". A refurbished gym located at the Torrington base in Australia has been turned into a kit with exquisite master-grade details. The internal frame is reproduced on the foot. The model has been recreated with great attention to detail, including the use of mesh pipes for the power pipes that run behind the knees. A cockpit block with detailed mechanics can be stored inside the fuselage. By using MarkingSeal and Gundam decals, you can reproduce the aircraft with sophisticated details. The weapon's 90mm machine gun can be recreated as a gym rifle by rearranging everything except the base. Other than that, it also comes with a beam spray gun, two beam sabers, and a seal that can be stored on the back.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場するトールギスIIIを1/144スケールモデルで再現しました。胴体パーツは胸部と腹部をボールジョイントで接続するため、腰のひねりを再現できます。肩アーマー部のブースターは劇中通りの展開が可能で、左右のマウントラッチにはメガキャノンとシールドを着脱できます。メガキャノンは展開状態のみですが、発射ポーズを再現できます。シールド下部にマウントするヒートロッドは長短2種が付いており、どちらかを選択して取り付けられ、シールド基部でスイングが可能です。トールギス、トールギスII用のパーツも付いていますので、どれか一つを選んで組み立てる事が出来ます。ドーバーガン、シールドはそれぞれ肩アーマー部にマウントでき、また手に持たせる事も可能です。
phrases.en: Tallgeese III that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz" is reproduced in 1/144 Scale Model. The torso parts connect the chest and abdomen with a ball joint, allowing you to recreate the twist of the waist. The booster on the shoulder armor can be deployed as shown in the movie, and the mega cannon and Seal can be attached and detached from the left and right mount latches. Mega Cannon can reproduce the firing pose only when it is in the expanded state. The heat rod that mounts at the bottom of the seal comes in two types, long and short, and can be installed by selecting one, and can be swung at the base of the seal. It also comes with parts for Tallgeese and Tallgeese II, so you can choose one and assemble it. The Dover gun and Seal can be mounted on the shoulder armor, and can also be held in the hand.

phrases.en: A Collections Model in which the entire exterior and internal skeleton of Char's personal Zaku, which is piloted by "Red Comet" Char, is completely reproduced. A figure of Char Aznable by the same Scale is included to enhance the story. The expansion and contraction mechanism of the joints accurately reproduces the dampers etc. that are linked to movement. It is possible to reproduce the full hatch opening by attaching and detaching the external armor, deploying the cockpit hatch, and moving the cockpit seat. The power pipe, which determines the Zaku's impression, has a built-in tightly wound spring, allowing for free movement. The movable soles improve ground contact, and the movable waist stabilizes and improves posing. Weapons include a Zaku machine gun and a heat hawk.

phrases.en: -New model of the magnetic coating exterior that symbolizes G-3 Gundam! The magnetic coating exterior parts on the left and right, inside and outside of the elbows, knees, and ankle guards are newly sculpted. The wide neck movement allows for dynamic poses such as flight scenes. The widely movable shoulder joint allows for a wide range of natural poses. The legs have a sliding mechanism that allows for follow-up movement, allowing the joints to be exposed by moving the knees, allowing for dense posing. Also equipped with a transformation mechanism from core block to core fighter.

phrases.ja: 立 ち 上 が る 砂 漠 の 雄 －ＭＳ－０９Ｇ ドワッジ　マスターグレードで登場！　『機動戦士ガンダムＺＺ』より、ドムの系譜を継ぐ量産型ＭＳ ドワッジをマスターグレードシリーズで商品化。特徴的な頭部、背部、リアアーマー、脚部、各種武装等を新規造形を交え忠実に再現。各関節パーツをアップデートし、ダイナミックなポージングが可能。　　●　ドワッジの機体形状を新規造形を交え徹底再現！　　ＭＳ－０９ドムをベースに新規パーツを加えドワッジの各形状を追求。　　　頭部　　バルカン砲4門を増設した頭部側面のディテールを新規造形で再現。　　　胴体　　胸部装甲から肩部にかけての装甲および動力パイプ部を新規パーツで再現。　　また後頭部からバックパックにかけての背部胴体装甲の形状も含む、　　胴体部全体を新規造形パーツで再現。　　　バックパック　　ホイップアンテナ、プロペラントタンクを装備。　　熱核ジェットエンジンの吸気口やスラスター内部のモールド形状など細部にわたり緻密に再現。　　側面にヒート・サーベルをマウント可能。　　　リアアーマー　　特徴的なリアアーマーの形状を新規造形で再現。　　ホバー走行時の防塵および放熱調整のための”ルーバー”の形状を精密に再現。　　　腕部　　腕部形状を新規造形で再現。　　関節部のモールドや装甲の色分けなどを新規パーツで徹底再現。　　　脚部　　脹脛へドロップタンクを追加。側面の特徴的なディテールも新規造形にて再現。　　●　武装各種を新規造形を交え再現！　　ドワッジの武装を新規造形を交え徹底再現。　　　ジャイアント・バズ　　スコープが撤去され、高熱帯地域での砲身加熱を抑えるためのサーマルジャケットや　　スモーク・ディスチャージャーが追加装備されたジャイアント・バズを一部新規パーツを交えて再現。　　　また角度の異なる引き起こし式リブを追加したグリップパーツにより、高い保持力とポージングの自由性を確保。　　　ヒート・トマホーク　　ヒート・ホークを両刃にした格闘兵器を新規造形で再現。　　　ヒート・サーベル　　ヒート・サーベルを新規造形で再現。内蔵した引き起こし式のリブにより、高い保持力を実現。　　●　関節機構をアップデート！　　ベースキットであるＭＧ ＭＳ－０９ドムから、関節部をアップデート。　　ＭＧ最新フォーマットの可動性能を携えての立体化。　　　肩関節　　両肩の前方へのスイング機構を実装。印象的なジャイアント・バズを構えるポーズが各部の干渉なくスムーズに決まる。　　　股関節　　腿の付け根から前後へのスイング機構を実装。足首の安定性と合わせて力強いポージングを実現。　　　太股部　　太股部には横のスイングが加わり、多彩な動きに対応。　　　エモーションマニピュレーター　　手首を最新ＭＧフォーマットで定着した、エモーションマニピュレーターへ変更。　　フレキシブルな五指独立可動を実現。　●　新規デザインを含む水転写式デカールが付属！　　付属武装 ：　ジャイアント・バズ　／　 ヒート・トマホーク　／　ヒート・サーベル　　　－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－1/100スケール組み立て式プラモデル対象年齢 ： 15才以上主な製品素材 ： ＰＳ ／ ＰＥ ／ＰＰ ／ ＡＢＳ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－　※写真の完成品は塗装してあります。また、開発途中の試作品です。実際の商品とは多少異なる場合がございます。　　　　（備考）　・ この商品は、プラモデルお取り扱い店舗店頭ではお買い求めいただけません。　・ この商品は、弊社主催イベントや他の企画などおよび海外で販売をさせていただく場合がございます。　・ この商品は‘プレミアムバンダイ’での販売準備数に限りがございます。品切れの際はご了承ください。　・ この商品は、生産準備数の都合により、お一人様につきご購入いただける数量を限らせていただいております。　　 ご了承ください。　・ この商品は、お申込状況、生産の都合により、発送日が変更となる場合がございます。予めご了承ください。　・ 商品画像は開発途中のものであり、実際の商品とは異なる場合がございます。　・ 商品仕様は2019年2月現在の予定です。変更の場合もございますがご了承ください。
phrases.en: The rising desert hero - MS-09G Dowadge now available in master grade! From "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", the mass-produced MS Dowadge, which inherits the lineage of Dom, is commercialized in the Master Grade series. The characteristic head, back, rear armor, legs, various weapons, etc. are faithfully reproduced with new modeling. Each joint part has been updated to allow for dynamic poses. ● Thoroughly reproduces Dowadge's aircraft shape with new modeling! Based on the MS-09 Dom, new parts are added to pursue the various shapes of Dodge. Head The details on the side of the head with four additional Vulcan cannons are reproduced with new modeling. Torso The armor from the chest armor to the shoulders and the power pipe section are reproduced with new parts. In addition, the entire torso, including the shape of the back torso armor from the back of the head to the backpack, is reproduced with new molded parts. Backpack equipped with whip antenna and propellant tank. The details such as the thermonuclear jet engine's intake port and the mold shape inside the thruster are precisely reproduced. A heat saber can be mounted on the side. Rear Armor The characteristic rear armor shape is reproduced with new modeling. Precisely reproduce the shape of the "louver" for dust prevention and heat radiation adjustment when hovering. Arm The arm shape is reproduced with new modeling. Thorough reproduction of joint molds and armor coloring with new parts. Legs Added drop tanks to the calves. The characteristic details on the sides are also reproduced with new modeling. ● Reproduce various weapons with new modeling! Dowadge's armament is thoroughly reproduced with new modeling. Giant Buzz The Giant Buzz, whose scope has been removed and is additionally equipped with a thermal jacket and smoke discharger to suppress gun barrel heating in high tropical regions, has been recreated with some new parts. In addition, grip parts with trigger-type ribs at different angles ensure high holding power and freedom of posing. Heat Tomahawk A double-edged combat weapon called Heat Hawk is reproduced with a new model. Heat saber Heat saber is reproduced with new modeling. The built-in pull-out rib provides high holding power. ● Updated joint mechanism! The joints have been updated from the base KitMG MS-09 Dom. Three-dimensional with the movable performance of MG's latest format. Shoulder joint Implements a forward swing mechanism for both shoulders. The pose of holding the impressive Giant Buzz is determined smoothly without any interference from other parts. Hip joint Implements a swing mechanism that swings back and forth from the base of the thigh. Combined with the stability of the ankle, it allows for powerful posing. Thighs The thighs have added lateral swing to accommodate a variety of movements. Emotion Manipulator Change your wrist to the Emotion Manipulator, which is established in the latest MG format. Realizes flexible independent movement of five fingers. ● Water transfer decals including new designs are included! 付属武装 ： ジャイアント・バズ ／ ヒート・トマホーク ／ ヒート・サーベル －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－1/100ScaleAssembly式プラModel対象齢 ： 15才以上主な製品素材 ： ＰＳ ／ ＰＥ ／ＰＰ ／ No adhesive is used for the ABS/Assembly. phrases.en: Get Zeon's amazing mechanism from "Mobile Suit Gundam"! Major Johnny Ridden's Zaku using the frame of Zaku Ver. 2.0 is now available in MG. Features of MS-06R-2 In addition to the leg thruster cover and spike armor, even the small details such as the forearm are reproduced. The leg thruster cover is removable. The power pipe is slide molded so that it can be assembled during the process of separating it from the Runner. A joint compatible with the action base can be attached to the hip joint. In addition to the Zaku Machine Gun, Zaku Bazooka, and Heat Hawk, a large-caliber Giant Bazooka is included.

phrases.ja: OVA「機動戦士ガンダム 0080 ポケットの中の戦争」に登場するジオン軍の特殊工作部隊“サイクロプス隊”がU.C.ハードグラフに登場。サイクロプス隊は「ポケットの中の戦争」に登場する以前のメンバー（ハーディ・シュタイナー大尉、ミハイル・カミンスキー少尉、アンディー・ストロース少尉、ガブリエル・ラミレス・ガルシア軍曹、ジェームズ・黄（ホワン）曹長）に加え、民間人の少年がセット。セットに付属する軽機動車「PVN.3/2 サウロペルタ」は前輪舵角、ボンネットと後部幌格納部の開閉、ウィンドウ可倒などが位置変更可能。タバコやスキットル、バンダナなど隊員を象徴する小物など豊富なオプションが付属。車両マーキングや隊員の襟章、部隊章にくわえ、迷彩服再現用の水転写デカールが付属。
phrases.en: The Zeon army's special operations unit "Cyclops Squad" that appears in the OVA "Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket" appears in U.C. Hard Graph. The Cyclops squad includes the previous members who appeared in "War in the Pocket" (Captain Hardy Steiner, Second Lieutenant Mikhail Kaminsky, Second Lieutenant Andy Strauss, Sergeant Gabriel Ramirez Garcia, and Sergeant Major James Huang), as well as a small number of civilians. The light mobility vehicle "PVN.3/2 Sauropelta" that comes with the set can change the front wheel steering angle, opening/closing of the bonnet and rear hood storage, and folding windows. A wide variety of options are included, such as cigarettes, kits, bandanas, and other accessories that symbolize the members. In addition to vehicle markings, member lapel pins, and unit badges, water transfer decals for reproducing camouflage uniforms are included.

phrases.ja: 1/100スケールで再現された「ウイングガンダムゼロ(エンドレスワルツ版)」の全身に渡りクロームメッキを施しました 。カメラアイをクリアーパーツ、胸部サーチアイをジュエルシールで再現しています 。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、広範囲な可動を実現しています 。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転が可能です 。肩部マシンキャノンは展開が可能で、肩アーマーは３枚の装甲が独立可動します 。背面4枚の翼が独立可動し、内側の小翼は差し替え式で展開状態を再現できます。ビーム・サーベルはクリアーパーツ製のビーム部分が取り外せ、柄は設定通り小翼基部に収納が可能です 。ツインバスターライフルは左右への合体分離が可能です。背面部4枚の翼の可動、及び足首周辺パーツの可動により、大気圏突入形態の再現が可能です 。各翼には精巧なモールドを施し、劇中設定を超えた精密感を再現しています 。1/20スケールのヒイロ・ユイのフィギュアが付いています
phrases.en: The entire body of "Wing Gundam Zero (Endless Waltz version)" reproduced in 1/100 Scale is chrome plated. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the chest search eye is reproduced with jewel seal. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to provide a wide range of movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, and the waist can be rotated. The shoulder machine cannon can be deployed, and the shoulder armor has three armor pieces that can move independently. The four wings on the back can move independently, and the small inner wings can be replaced to recreate the unfolded state. The beam saber's clear beam part can be removed, and the handle can be stored at the base of the small wing as specified. The Twin Buster Rifle can be combined and separated to the left and right. By moving the four wings on the back and moving the parts around the ankle, it is possible to reproduce the atmosphere entry form. Each wing has an elaborate mold, reproducing a sense of precision that goes beyond the setting in the play. Comes with a 1/20 scale Heero Yui figure.

phrases.en: Jegan D type sortie - From "Mobile Suit Gundam NT", the Jegan, whose aircraft has been customized for special missions such as escort missions, is now available in the HGUC series! phrases.en: －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ Don't take the Royal Guard lightly! - AMX-117R Gaz RAMX-117L Gaz Ⅼ now available as a set of 2! －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ From "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", Gaz R and Gaz V, members of the Neo Zeon military guard "Royal Guard", are now available in the HG series as a set of two! Each distinctive aircraft is reproduced with new molded parts, molded colors, and water transfer decals with engraved details! ● Reproduce the distinctive silhouette and weapons with new modeling! The MS body and weapons, such as the head antenna and feet, are reproduced with new modeling. ・Shoulders, arms Newly sculpted shoulder armor and arm shapes. Reproduces the symmetrical and impressive silhouettes of the two Gaz R and Gaz L machines. ・Backpack New model of backpack. The Hyper Beam Saber equipment is reproduced as per the setting in the play. In addition, Beam Naginata effect parts are included and can be attached to the hilt of the Hyper Beam Saber. ・Heat Lance The characteristic "Royal Guard" main weapon Heat Lance is included as a new model. ● The aircraft color and armor engraving are thoroughly reproduced with molded color and water transfer decals! The unique aircraft color and decoration of the "Royal Guard" in the movie are reproduced with molded colors and luxurious water transfer decals. ・Aircraft color: The silver shining exterior part is reproduced with a metallic molding color that gives a profound feeling. ・Water transfer decal The engravings from the MS body to the weapons are reproduced with luxurious water transfer decals, creating a noble and demonstrative decoration of the "Royal Guard." ● A variety of action poses are realized with newly designed special hand parts! Hand parts for Hyper Beam Saber are included. Coupled with the range of motion of the latest HG main unit, it is possible to take action poses unique to an aircraft specialized in hand-to-hand combat. Attached weapons: Heat Lance / Beam Rifle / Hyper Beam Saber (Beam Naginata) / Beam Saber 1/144 Scale Assembly type plastic model Target age: 8 years old Above product materials: No adhesive is used for PS/PE/Assemblies. *The finished product in the photo is painted. Separation, transformation, and combination mechanisms into Core Fighter, Top Fighter, and Bottom Fighter forms can be reproduced without replacing parts. The head is movable using a ball joint. The camera eye is made of clear parts. The head can be stored in the fuselage and the extension/folding mechanism of the nose can be reproduced. The elbow beam and base of the seal are movable, making it possible to attach and remove the seal. A ball joint is used for the wrist joint, and the fingers are movable. Comes with a beam rifle and two beam sabers.

Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, and the waist can be rotated. The waist armor has a front part with integrated left and right sides, a movable side part, and hatches on the chest and both shoulders that can be opened and closed without replacement. The army knife on the right forearm can be deployed as shown in the movie. The Gatling gun can be attached to and removed from the left arm by replacing it with the wrist, and can also be mounted on a backpack. Comes with a figure of Trois that recreates the pose he appears in in the opening.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムWエンドレスワルツ」に登場する主人公機「ウイングガンダムゼロ(エンドレスワルツ版)」の1/144スケールモデルが全身クリアーパーツとメッキパーツの特別バージョンで登場です 。首、股関節、足首に新型のボールジョイントを使用、他の間接部も新設計のジョイントを使用することにより、可動範囲の広角化及び、完成後の着脱を可能にしました 。胸部と腹部も独自に回転し、腰アーマーもフロント部とサイド部が可動します 。手首は平手、拳、武器用握り手がそれぞれ付いています 。劇中のアクションポーズを再現する為のファイティング・アクション用パーツとして、肩の軸が前方にスライドし、胸部が前屈した胴体が別途に付いており、ツインバスターライフル斉射ポーズを再現できます 。ツインバスターライフルは左右が合体・分離可能です 。背面4枚の翼は広範囲に可動し、差し替えなしで大気圏突入状態を再現できます 。光輝くそのボディが、この機体の持つ幻想的な雰囲気をより印象強く表現しています
phrases.en: The 1/144 Scale Model of the main character "Wing Gundam Zero (Endless Waltz version)" that appears in "New Mobile Report Gundam W Endless Waltz" is now available in a special version with full body clear parts and plated parts. New ball joints are used for the neck, hip joints, and ankles, and newly designed joints are used for other joints, allowing for a wide range of motion and allowing for attachment and detachment after completion. The chest and abdomen also rotate independently, and the front and side parts of the waist armor can move. The wrists have an open hand, a fist, and a weapon grip. As fighting action parts to reproduce the action poses from the movie, a separate torso with the shoulder axes sliding forward and the chest bending forward is included, allowing you to recreate the Twin Buster Rifle salvo firing pose. The left and right sides of the Twin Buster Rifle can be combined and separated. The four wings on the back can be moved over a wide range, allowing you to recreate the atmosphere entering the atmosphere without having to replace them. Its shining body expresses the fantastic atmosphere of this aircraft even more impressively.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」に登場するゼクス・マーキスが搭乗するトールギスが1/144スケールモデルで登場。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部は別パーツになっており、腰の回転が可能な他、サイドの腰アーマーが可動します。両肩アーマーに取り付けるブースターは、劇中通りの展開機構を再現しています。肩アーマーの左右には、それぞれドーバーガンとシールドをマウントするラッチを装備しています。また、両装備は手に持たせる事も可能です。他にビームサーベルが付いています。勇ましい軍服姿をしたゼクスのフィギュアが付いています。

The chest and abdomen are separate parts, the waist can be rotated, and the side waist armor can be moved. The boosters attached to both shoulder armor reproduce the deployment mechanism as seen in the movie. The left and right sides of the shoulder armor are equipped with latches to mount the Dover Gun and Seal respectively. Also, both equipment can be held in the hand. Also comes with a beam saber. A figure of Zechs wearing a brave military uniform is included.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場するガンダムヘビーアームズカスタムの1/144スケールモデルを全身クリアーパーツとメッキパーツの特別バージョンで再現しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用した他、各関節部も新設計のジョイントを使用し、可動のクリアランスとともに、重量感のある武器の保持も問題なく行えます。胸部ガトリングハッチと肩アーマー前後のミサイルハッチは開閉可能で、他にファイティング・アクション用パーツとして、腰アーマーフロント部とサイド部、及びすね側面のミサイルハッチフルオープン状態のパーツが別途に付いています。胸部と腹部は別パーツになっており、腰の回転が可能です。ダブルガトリングは前腕部のほか、バックパックの専用ラックにも装着できます。
phrases.en: The 1/144 Scale Model of the Gundam Heavy Arms Custom that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz" is reproduced with a special version of full body clear parts and plated parts. In addition to using ball joints for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, each joint also uses newly designed joints, allowing for free movement and the ability to hold heavy weapons without any problems. The chest gatling hatch and the missile hatches on the front and back of the shoulder armor can be opened and closed, and parts for the front and side parts of the waist armor, as well as the missile hatch on the side of the shin in a fully open state, are also included as fighting action parts. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, and the waist can be rotated. Double Gatling can be attached to the forearm or to the special rack of the backpack.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊」に登場する「陸戦型ガンダム」と「ザク2 J型」の2アイテムのセットです。陸戦型ガンダムはパーツの組み換えにより3タイプの頭部が再現できます。背部にウェポンコンテナの着脱が可能、コンテナのハッチはの開閉出来ます。武器は180mmキャノン、100mmマシンガン、ビーム・サーベル2本、ビーム・ライフル、シールドが再現されています。ザクII J型の頭部は、一般兵用と角の付いた指揮官用が選択できます。胸部のコクピットハッチは着脱可能、内部のメカディテールも再現されています。機体各所の動力パイプは軟質素材で再現されていて、可動の邪魔になりません。武器はザクマシンガンとザクバズーカが付いています。
phrases.en: A set of two items: "Ground Type Gundam" and "Zaku 2 J Type" that appear in "Mobile Suit Gundam 08th MS Platoon". The ground battle type Gundam can reproduce three types of heads by rearranging parts. The Weapon container can be attached and removed on the back, and the container hatch can be opened and closed. Weapons include a 180mm cannon, 100mm machine gun, two beam sabers, a beam rifle, and a Seal. The head of the Zaku II J type can be selected for general soldiers or for commanders with horns. The cockpit hatch on the chest is removable, and the internal mechanical details are also reproduced. The power pipes in various parts of the aircraft are made of soft material and do not interfere with movement. Weapons include a Zaku machine gun and a Zaku bazooka.

phrases.en: This is a three-dimensional version of the mobile suit Gunigi that appeared on TV "Mobile Suit V Gundam" that was developed for use in space battles. The beam and seal are molded as clear parts and can be attached and detached from the main body. By selecting the chest parts, it is also possible to recombine with the old generation machine Gun Aigi. The backpack's thruster has a ball joint at the base. Comes with a beam rifle, beam pistol, mega beam bazooka, and two types of beam sabers. Includes display stand and card.

The mega particle cannon at the bottom of the fuselage is deployable, making it possible to reproduce the firing state. Comes with two types of GundamGP01Fbg of the same Scale 1/550. Comes with a display stand with the Zeon Principality emblem on it.

phrases.en: Acguy's MG series plastic model that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam". The arm part uses a mechanism for the first time in plastic model history, reproducing the telescopic gimmick and the movement of the elbow joint. The claw extension storage gimmick on the right forearm is also reproduced, and the Vulcan cannon has a switch function and can be deployed with a spring action. Parts to express the firing scene can be attached to the torpedo on the left arm. A display stand is included that allows you to recreate underwater scenes. Figures of the children who were on board the White Base, Katsu, Retsu, and Kikka are included.

Comes with foil seal.

Reproduces the characteristics of the S-type Zaku, such as the school bag on the back and the thrusters on the legs. Two types of head antennas are included, "normal" and "stable". The twisting and link movement of each part reproduces new ranges of movement that were not possible before, such as bending forward poses. Monoeye is equipped with a line-of-sight movement gimmick linked to the movement of the neck. Two 1/100 scale figures of Char Aznable (standing and seated for cockpit boarding) are included. Weapons include Zaku machine gun, Zaku bazooka, and heat hawk. Comes with a lift vehicle that allows you to recreate the scene of boarding an MS.

Ball joints are used for the wrists, hips, and ankles, and the chest and abdomen are separate parts, allowing for smooth movement. The shoulder armor part swings up and down, and the sliding mechanism is also reproduced. The backpack is movable, and a bazooka and beam cannon can be mounted by attaching a special rack. Other weapons include two double gatling guns. Comes with 1/20 Scale figures of Lilina Dorian and Mariemeia Kushrinada.

phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam", the mass-produced mobile suit developed by the Earth Federation army during the first war based on RX-78 data is turned into a kit with MG's unique best proportions. Inside the fuselage, there is a built-in cockpit block that has been reproduced with elaborate mechanical details based on the new settings. Seal can be mounted to the connector provided on the left arm. Attach the bazooka rack to your backpack and mount the hyper bazooka. Jim's special weapon, the beam spray gun, can be mounted on the holder on his waist. Also includes weapons such as a beam rifle and beam saber.

A ball joint is used at the hip joint. The waist side armor and left and right front armor can move independently. The ankle armor part is movable. Comes with a beam gun, a seal, and two beam sabers.

Silver plated parts are used for each part such as the beam size pattern. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement, and the fingers are also movable, and the elbows and knees are double jointed. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, allowing you to reproduce the rotation of the hips. n The beam size in the stored state can be mounted on the rear armor at the waist, and the beam generating part can be moved in the expanded state. Buster Seal's blade can be opened and closed, and beam parts can be attached to the tip. Various beam parts and camera eyes are reproduced with clear parts, and image improvement parts also made of clear parts are also included.

phrases.ja: MG（マスターグレードシリーズ）や、HGUC（ハイグレードユニバーサルセンチュリーシリーズ）等、プラスチックモデルキットのコンセプトデザインを 手がけるカトキハジメ氏が、小説「機動戦士ガンダムUC」（福井晴敏著） に登場する「ユニコーンガンダム」のライバル機「シナンジュ」を〔Ver.Ka〕（カトキハジメバージョン）として、全面監修した”デザイナーズMG”第 6弾 「シナンジュ」の特徴である全身の有機的フォルムを完全再現 背面大型バックパックには、スラスター展開時に外装パーツと連動するスライドギミックを内蔵。脚部にはフレキシブルスラスターを装備 コクピット内部を再現し、ハッチオープンも可能。またモノアイを有する頭部には連動した可動機構も内蔵され、そのメカニズムを楽しむことができる 複雑な形状のシールドを、イメージそのままに再現。またシールド背面には、ビーム・アックスを収納／展開することができるマウントアームを装備 シールドに装着されるグレネードランチャーは、専用ライフルへの着脱も可能。グレネード装填ギミックも再現 ビーム・サーベルとビーム・アックスは、大型エフェクトとして発光をイメージしたクリアイエローで成型 小説「機動戦士ガンダムU.C.」を連載する「月刊ガンダムエース」編集部が、作品世界や機体を解説する説明書が付属 全身のマーキングはガンダムデカールで再現。ゴールド部分にはシールを採用し、スペシャルオプションとして同形状のスライドマークも付属
phrases.en: Mr. Hajime Katoki, who handles the concept design of plastic Model Kits such as MG (Master Grade Series) and HGUC (High Grade Universal Century Series), has completely supervised the 6th edition of "Designer's MG" with the "Sinanju", a rival machine of "Unicorn Gundam" that appears in the novel "Mobile Suit GundamUC" (written by Harutoshi Fukui), as [Ver.Ka] (Hajime Katoki version). The characteristic of "Sinanju" is a complete reproduction of the organic form of the whole body.The large backpack on the back has a built-in slide gimmick that interlocks with the exterior parts when the thruster is deployed. Equipped with flexible thrusters on the legs The inside of the cockpit is reproduced, and the hatch can be opened. In addition, the head with a mono-eye has a built-in movable mechanism that allows you to enjoy the mechanism.The complex shape of Seal is reproduced exactly as imagined. In addition, the back of the Seal is equipped with a mount arm that can store and deploy the beam ax. The grenade launcher attached to the Seal can also be attached to and removed from a special rifle. The grenade loading gimmick is also reproduced.The beam saber and beam ax are molded in clear yellow with the image of luminescence as a large effect.The editorial department of Gundam Ace, which serializes the novel "Mobile Suit Gundam U.C.," comes with a manual that explains the world of the work and the aircraft.The markings on the whole body are reproduced with Gundam decals. Seal is used for the gold part, and a slide mark of the same shape is also included as a special option.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」の物語中盤より登場したウイングガンダムゼロが1/144スケールでキット化しました。首、手首、股関節及びウイングバーニア基部にボールジョイントを使用し、また胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、フレキシブルな可動を再現しています。肩アーマーのサイド部、及び腰アーマーのフロント部とサイド部も可動します。左右の着脱が可能なツインバスターライフルは、ネオバード形態時にはシールドにマウントできます。他にビームサーベル1本が付いています。ふくらはぎのハッチが開閉可能です。ウイングバーニア部の差し替えにより、ネオバード形態への変形が可能です。
phrases.en: Wing Gundam Zero, which appeared in the middle of the story of "Mobile Suit Gundam W", has been made into a kit in 1/144 scale. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hip joints, and base of the wing vernier, and the chest and abdomen are separate parts to reproduce flexible movement. The side parts of the shoulder armor and the front and side parts of the waist armor are also movable. The twin buster rifle, which can be attached and detached on the left and right sides, can be mounted on Seal when in neobird form. Also includes one beam saber. Calf hatch can be opened and closed. By replacing the wing vernier part, it can be transformed into Neobird form.

As set, the frame is inherited from Zaku II Ver. 2.0 and high action is maintained.The cannon pack is removable, and details are reproduced down to the connecting bolt with the main body.The rocket launcher can be attached to the back of the waist, and the attachment and detachment of the magazine is also reproduced.The head can be selected from normal type and rabbit type.Various markings to create a realistic world view are included.Zaku machine gun, Zaku bazooka, and heat hawk are also included.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム」より、「黒い三連星」がドムに乗る以前、宇宙で使用していた専用のR 型ザクIIをキット化しました。R-1A型の独特な前腕部バルジはもちろん、脚部、バックパックの細やかなディティールの細部に至るまで再現しました。ジャイアントバズーカへの過渡期であるバズーカはパーツを組み替えられ、2つの形態を楽しめます。バズーカ以外にザクマシンガン、ヒートホークを装備しています。「黒い三連星」の一人、マッシュの1/20スケールフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam", the exclusive R-type Zaku II that was used in space before the "Black Tri-Star" rode on Dom has been made into a kit. Not only the R-1A model's unique forearm bulge, but also the fine details of the legs and backpack have been recreated. The parts of the transitional bazooka to the giant bazooka can be rearranged and you can enjoy two forms. In addition to the bazooka, it is equipped with a Zaku machine gun and a heat hawk. Comes with a 1/20 scale figure of Mash, one of the "Black Tri-Stars".

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW」に登場する５体のガンダムの1体、ウイングガンダムがリアルなディテールの1/100スケールモデルで登場です。頭部アンテナや胸のインテーク部分など各部にゴールドメッキパーツを使用しています。首と股関節にボールジョイントを採用しています。カメラアイをクリアーパーツで、胸部サーチアイをジュエルシールで再現しています。指は可動指を採用しています。ウイングの開閉を差し替えなしで再現しています。ひざが三重関節になっている他、足首はつま先とかかとが独立可動し、足首アーマーも可動します。主武器であるバスターライフルはグリップの収納が可能で、バード形態には機首シールドに装着されます。パーツの差し替えなしで、バード形態への変形が可能です。前腕部はクローの展開と、手首の収納を再現しています。他にクリアーパーツ製のビームサーベル1本とウイング部に装着するイメージアップパーツが付いています。
phrases.en: Wing Gundam, one of the five Gundams appearing in "Mobile Suit GundamW", is now available as a 1/100 Scale Model with realistic details. Gold-plated parts are used for various parts such as the head antenna and the chest intake part. Ball joints are used in the neck and hip joints. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the chest search eye is reproduced with jewel seal. The fingers are movable. The opening and closing of the wing is reproduced without replacement. In addition to the triple-jointed knees, the toes and heels of the ankles can move independently, and the ankle armor can also move. The main weapon Buster Rifle can be stored in the grip, and in Bird form it is attached to the nose seal. Can be transformed into bird form without replacing parts. The forearm reproduces the unfolding of the claw and the storage of the wrist. Also includes a beam saber made of clear parts and image enhancement parts that can be attached to the wing.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場するガンダムデスサイズヘルカスタムを1/144スケールモデルで再現しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用する他、その他の各関節部にも新設計のジョイントパーツを使用し、スムーズで広範囲な可動を実現しています。ビームシザースを大きく振り上げたポーズを再現するため、肩の軸を傾け、腰をひねった状態の胴体パーツがファイティング・アクション用パーツとして付いています。肩アーマーは後ハメが可能で、ブレードが独立して可動します。アクティブクローク中央に位置するバックパックの上下スイングが可能です。アクティブクロークの開閉は差し替え式で再現しています。劇中設定に新たな解釈を加え、美しい曲線と、精巧なモールドを配してあります。
phrases.en: Reproduce the Gundam Death Scythe Hell custom that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz" with 1/144 Scale Model. In addition to using ball joints for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, newly designed joint parts are used for each other joint to achieve smooth and wide range of movement. In order to reproduce the pose of swinging the beam scissors wide, torso parts with the shoulders tilted and hips twisted are included as fighting action parts. The shoulder armor can be attached to the back, and the blade can be moved independently. The backpack located in the center of the active cloakroom can be swung up and down. The opening and closing of the active cloak is reproduced with a replacement type. A new interpretation of the setting in the play, with beautiful curves and elaborate molds.

In addition, it comes with two beam sabers stored on its waist, a seal that is indispensable for transformation, a grenade pack attached to the arm, and Zeta Gundam's biggest weapon, the Hyper Mega Launcher. Comes with a fearless figure of "Camille Bidan" reproduced in 1/20 scale.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場するトールギスIIIを精巧な1/100スケールで再現しました。トールギス、トールギスII、トールギスIIIの3つから選択式で一つを組み立てる事ができるコンバーチブルキットです。胸部と腹部が別パーツになっており、腰の回転が可能な他、腰サイドアーマーが可動します。増加装甲を装備した右肩アーマーにメガキャノン、左肩にシールドを装備しています。ブースターは、それぞれ左右のハッチが連動して展開する機構を再現しています。またメガキャノンは差し替えなしで、最大出力形態を再現できるます。シールドは、下部に多重関節ヒートロッドを装備でき、裏のラックにはビームサーベルの柄2本が装着できます。トールギス、トールギスIIに組み立てた場合、ドーバーガンとラウンドシールドを肩アーマーに装着できます。火消しのウインドの1/20フィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: The Tallgeese III that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz" is reproduced in an elaborate 1/100 scale. A convertible kit that allows you to select and assemble one of three types: Tallgeese, Tallgeese II, and Tallgeese III. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, the waist can be rotated, and the waist side armor can be moved. Equipped with a mega cannon on the right shoulder armor equipped with increased armor and a Seal on the left shoulder. The booster reproduces the mechanism in which the left and right hatches expand in conjunction with each other. Also, the Mega Cannon can reproduce the maximum output form without replacing it. Seal can be equipped with a multi-joint heat rod at the bottom, and two beam saber handles can be attached to the rack on the back. When assembled into Tallgeese or Tallgeese II, the Dover Gun and Round Seal can be attached to the shoulder armor. Comes with a 1/20 figure of Fireman Wind.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」物語中盤より登場する新主役機ウイングガンダムゼロが1/100スケールでモデル化しました。頭部アンテナなど各部にゴールドメッキパーツを使用しています。首、手首、股関節、足首にはボールジョイントを使用し、腰や指も可動します。カメラアイはクリアーパーツで、胸部サーチアイはジュエルシールで再現し、両肩のマシンキャノンはカバーの取り外しで展開状態を再現できます。ツインバスターライフルは、左右への分離・合体が可能で、ネオバード形態時にもシールドの左右に装着できます。両肩のサーベルラックは開閉可能です。また、ふくらはぎのハッチが開閉します。差し替えなしでネオバード形態への変形が可能です。ウイングバーニアの展開機構も、差し替えなしで再現しています。クリアーパーツ製ののイメージアップパーツがシールドへ着脱可能です。
phrases.en: The new main character Wing Gundam Zero, which appears from the middle of the story in "Mobile Suit Gundam W", has been made into a 1/100 scale model. Gold-plated parts are used for each part such as the head antenna. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, and the hips and fingers are also movable. The camera eye is made of clear parts, the chest search eye is made of jewel seal, and the machine cannons on both shoulders can be recreated in their deployed state by removing the covers. The Twin Buster Rifle can be separated and combined to the left and right, and can be attached to Seal's left and right sides even in Neobird mode. The saber racks on both shoulders can be opened and closed. Also, the calf hatch opens and closes. Can be transformed into Neobird form without replacement. The wing vernier deployment mechanism is also reproduced without replacement. Image-up parts made of clear parts can be attached to and removed from Seal.

phrases.ja: Figure-riseMechanics ドラえもん登場！Figure-riseMechanicsはロボットの内部メカニックを組み立てる新境地へ！■ドラえもんの特徴的な「ペタリハンド」や「ウルトラ・スーパー・デラックス・コンピュータ」などの内部メカのディテールを精密に再現！■組み立てていくことで、ドラえもんの内部メカが理解でき、よりドラえもんを知ることができます！■外装パーツは、通常のブルーの他に、内部メカが透けて見えるクリア外装も付属！組み立てた後も内部メカが見えるディスプレイが楽しめます。■タイムマシン座り用パーツが付属し、同時発売「Figure-riseMechanics ドラえもんのひみつ道具 タイムマシン」に乗せることも可能です。■口を別パーツにすることでシールレスを実現。さらに作りやすくなった！
phrases.en: Figure-riseMechanics Doraemon appears! Figure-riseMechanics takes you to a new frontier in assembling the internal mechanics of robots! ■Details of Doraemon's characteristic "petari hand" and internal mechanisms such as "Ultra Super Deluxe Computer" are precisely reproduced! ■By going through Assembly, you can understand Doraemon's internal mechanism and get to know Doraemon even more! ■In addition to the usual blue exterior parts, a clear exterior that allows you to see the internal mechanism is also included! Enjoy the display that allows you to see the internal mechanism even after assembly. ■Parts for sitting the time machine are included, and it can also be placed on the "Figure-riseMechanics Doraemon's Secret Tool Time Machine" released at the same time. ■ Seal-less is achieved by making the mouth a separate part. It's even easier to make!

Screws are used to secure the forearm, thigh, chest and seal. Die-casting is used for the shoulder joint, hip joint, and internal shin frame. The left arm saber rack can be opened and closed. The cylinder parts at the knees are movable. Reproduces the calf thruster cover opening/closing mechanism. New Hyper Bazooka can be mounted on a backpack. All six fin funnels are movable. Other weapons include a beam rifle and beam saber.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場する主人公機「ウイングガンダムゼロ(エンドレスワルツ版)」が1/144スケールでモデル化しました。首、股関節、足首に新型のボールジョイントを使用、他の間接部も新設計のジョイントを使用することにより、可動範囲の広角化及び、完成後の着脱を可能にしました 。胸部と腹部も独自に回転し、腰アーマーもフロント部とサイド部が可動します 。手首は平手、拳、武器用握り手がそれぞれ付いています 。劇中のアクションポーズを再現する為のファイティング・アクション用パーツとして、肩の軸が前方にスライドし、胸部が前屈した胴体が別途に付いており、ツインバスターライフル斉射ポーズを再現できます。 ツインバスターライフルは左右が合体・分離可能です。 背面4枚の翼は広範囲に可動し、差し替えなしで大気圏突入状態を再現できる他、大型の翼は軟質素材製で、手で曲げるなどして表情をつけることができます
phrases.en: The main character aircraft "Wing Gundam Zero (Endless Waltz version)" that appears in "New Mobile Report GundamW Endless Waltz" is modeled in 1/144 scale. New ball joints are used for the neck, hip joints, and ankles, and newly designed joints are used for other joints, allowing for a wide range of motion and allowing for attachment and detachment after completion. The chest and abdomen also rotate independently, and the front and side parts of the waist armor can move. The wrists have an open hand, a fist, and a weapon grip. As a fighting action part to reproduce the action pose from the movie, a separate torso with the shoulder axis sliding forward and the chest bending forward is included, allowing you to recreate the twin buster rifle salvo pose. The left and right sides of the Twin Buster Rifle can be combined and separated. The four wings on the back can be moved over a wide range, allowing you to recreate the state of entering the atmosphere without having to replace them.The large wings are made of soft material and can be bent with your hands to create different expressions.

The complex color coding of the main body and Seal is reproduced by clever parts division. The base of the propellant tank reproduces the metal texture with plating. The characteristic back fins and funnels are removable and can be deployed individually into attack forms. Fin Funnel can be recreated in flight with effect parts that reproduce spray flames, and the image of when the beam is fired is also reproduced with a clear sheet.A display stand with adjustable mounting angle is included.The stand can display not only the Hi-νGundam itself, but also the attack form of Fin Funnel.Equipments include beam rifle, new hyper bazooka, beam saber x 3, fin funnel x 6, and Sealdo.

phrases.en: A special version of the kit from "Mobile Suit Gundam" with a chrome-plated coating on the entire body. A convertible kit that allows you to reproduce the "F type" for space battles and the "J type" for ground battles by rearranging the backpack and leg verniers. The chest cockpit hatch can be opened and closed, and even the pilot figure of the same scale is accurately reproduced inside. Comes with Zaku machine gun, Heat Hawk, Zaku Bazooka, MMP-80 machine gun, spare magazine, 2 crackers, and 2 triple missile pods that can be attached to the legs. Comes with a fearless figure of a "Zeon soldier" reproduced in 1/20 scale.

The internal frame is reproduced on the foot. The model has been recreated with great attention to detail, including the use of mesh pipes for the power pipes that run behind the knees. A cockpit block with detailed mechanics can be stored inside the fuselage. By using MarkingSeal and Gundam decals, you can reproduce the aircraft with sophisticated details. The weapon's 90mm machine gun can be recreated as a gym rifle or long rifle by rearranging the parts. Other than that, it also comes with a beam spray gun, two beam sabers, and a seal that can be stored on the back.

phrases.en: The main mecha that appeared in the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam F91" is three-dimensionalized in 1/60 big scale. Face cover and head armor are removable. The magazine for the Vulcan cannon can be installed inside the head armor. The shoulder armor can deploy and store the stabilizer. Beam Seal is made of clear parts that can be used to expand and store gimmicks, and the base can be stored in the left forearm. The blade of the beam saber is removable, and the base can be stored in the left side armor. The triple calf thruster deploys in conjunction with the ankle suspension. The beam launcher can be mounted on the back armor. Vesper on the back is movable. The fingers are movable. Comes with a beam rifle. It comes with figures of pilots Seabook Annaud and Cecily Fairchild in the same scale.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」に登場するウイングガンダムゼロのライバル機、ガンダムエピオンを1/100スケールモデルで再現しました。前腕部クローなど各部にゴールドメッキパーツを使用しています。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、また全ての指、腰アーマーが独立して可動します。胸部と腹部が別パーツになっており、腰のひねりが可能な他、前腕のクロー、すね中央部がスイングします。カメラアイをクリアーパーツで、胸部中央のサーチアイをジュエルシールで再現しています。背面ウイングは広範囲に可動し、変形に必要なクリアランスを確保しています。ヒートロッドはパーツごとに可動し、シールドへの着脱が可能です。ビームソードの柄は腰サイドアーマーにマウントでき、またビニール製のエネルギーチューブにも着脱できます。刃部はノーマルとハイパー状の2種類が付きます。手首の着脱のみで、ＭＡ形態への変形が再現できます。背面ウイング基部へ着脱可能なクリアーパーツ製のイメージアップパーツが付いています。
phrases.en: A 1/100 Scale Model of Gundam Epyon, a rival aircraft of Wing Gundam Zero that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam W". Gold plated parts are used for each part such as the forearm claw. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, and all fingers and waist armor can move independently. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, the waist can be twisted, the forearm claws and the center of the shin can swing. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the search eye in the center of the chest is reproduced with a jewel seal. The rear wing can move over a wide range, ensuring the necessary clearance for transformation. The heat rod is movable for each part and can be attached to and detached from the Seal. The handle of the beam sword can be mounted on the waist side armor, and can also be attached to and detached from the vinyl energy tube. There are two types of blades: normal and hyper. Transformation into MA form can be recreated by simply attaching and detaching the wrists. Comes with image-enhancing parts made of clear parts that can be attached to and removed from the base of the rear wing.

phrases.ja: マンガ「機動戦士ガンダム外伝宇宙、閃光の果てに…」に登場するガンダム4号機がMGシリーズにラインナップ。肩部増加スラスターとプロペラントタンクは着脱可能、ノーマルと増加形態の2パターンが再現可能です。腕のビームガンとスネ後方のスラスターは着脱でき、接続部には精巧なメカモールドが再現されています。肩関節は引き出し可動により、両腕で武器を構えるポーズも容易に再現できます。足首関節は2重構造により開脚時の接地性が向上しています。バックパックは外装が着脱可能、内部メカにはメカモールドを再現しています。武器はメガランチャー、ビームライフル、ビームサーベル2本、折り畳み式のシールドを装備しています。メガランチャーのエネルギーケーブルはリード線で再現しています。
phrases.en: Gundam Unit 4 that appears in the manga "Mobile Suit Gundam Gaiden: At the End of the Flash..." is now available in the MG series. The shoulder thruster and propellant tank are removable, and two patterns, normal and increased form, can be reproduced. The beam gun on the arm and the thruster behind the shin can be attached and detached, and the connection part has an elaborate mechanical mold. The shoulder joints can be pulled out and moved, allowing you to easily recreate the pose of holding a weapon with both arms. The ankle joint has a double structure, which improves ground contact when the legs are spread. The exterior of the backpack is removable, and the internal mechanism reproduces the mechanical mold. Weapons include a mega launcher, beam rifle, two beam sabers, and a foldable seal. Mega Launcher's energy cable is reproduced with lead wire.

phrases.ja: • 劉備ガンダムの新装備バージョンをサイズ約160ミリで大型化。 • 雷装 張飛の左肩鎧、鬼牙装 関羽右肩鎧にが付属、新三位一体に換装できる。 　肩鎧は台座に飾ることが可能。 • メッキパーツを多用、まさに豪華な劉備ガンダム。 • 腰前垂れ、肩の横鎧の一部にシボ加工処理。 • 額クリスタルと目を透明パーツで再現。 • 胸部、手甲部の銀色部分に金属的表現でガラス粉いりインクの特殊シールを使 　用。 • 大型スケールならではの、ひざ、ひじが可動。親指、人差し指、中指が可動 • 後頭部のレバーを回すことで目の表情が変化。 • 背中左右の羽が連動した開閉ギミック。 • 専用の武器「龍帝剣（通常）」「真龍帝剣（覚醒時）メッキ」「爪龍刀（そうりゅうとう）が 　付属。 • 右足には「龍装」、左足には「劉備」の刻印。 • 別売りのアクションベースIに対応するパーツが付属。 龍帝剣2種×各1、真爪龍刀×1、雷装張飛ガンダム鎧、龍のかざりパーツ×各1、鬼牙装関羽ガンダム、肩鎧、龍かかざりパーツ×1、鎧台座×1
phrases.en: • The new equipped version of Liu Bei Gundam has been enlarged to approximately 160mm in size. • Thunder armor for Zhang Fei's left shoulder armor and Kiga armor for Guan Yu's right shoulder armor are included, and can be replaced with the new Trinity. The shoulder armor can be displayed on the pedestal. • A truly luxurious Liu Bei Gundam that uses many plated parts. • Texture treatment on the front of the waist and part of the side armor on the shoulders. • The forehead crystal and eyes are reproduced with transparent parts. • A special seal made of glass powder ink is used on the silver parts of the chest and back of the hands to give it a metallic look. • Knees and elbows are movable, unique to the large scale. Thumb, index finger, and middle finger are movable • The expression of the eyes changes by turning the lever on the back of the head. • Opening/closing gimmick with interlocking wings on the left and right sides of the back. • Special weapons "Dragon Emperor Sword (Normal)", "Shin Dragon Emperor Sword (Awakened) Plated", and "Claw Dragon Sword" are included. • "Dragon Armor" is engraved on the right leg and "Liu Bei" is engraved on the left leg. • Parts compatible with Action Base I (sold separately) are included. 2 types of dragon emperor swords x 1 each, true claw dragon sword x 1, Raiso Haruhei Gundam armor, dragon ornament parts x 1 each, Onigaso Kanu Gundam, shoulder armor, dragon ornament parts x 1, armor pedestal x 1

phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam", this kit has a smart silhouette unique to Gundam's direct successor, which was developed after 7 years of war. The movable frame has been reproduced on the foot as set, and by removing the removable exterior, you can enjoy the internal mechanism that has been reproduced, including the expansion and contraction of the damper. The power pipes in each part of the aircraft are realistically reproduced down to the texture using mesh pipes. It is equipped with various weapons such as a detachable Vulcan pod with a detachable head, a beam rifle with a foldable sensor sight, a hyper bazooka that can be mounted on the latch on the waist, two beam sabers attached to the backpack, and a retractable Seal.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」より、大破し月面基地で強化されたデスサイズ、ガンダムデスサイズヘルを1/144スケールモデルで再現しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現している他、指もそれぞれ可動し、またひざは二重関節になっています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転を再現できます。ツイン・ビーム・サイズの2本の刃はそれぞれ独立して可動し、収納状態の柄は腰リアアーマーにマウント出来ます。新型バスターシールドの先端部の刃の開閉も可能で、ビームパーツの着脱も出来ます。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰のひねりを実現しています。アクティブクロークの展開機構は、差し替えなしで劇中のアクションを再現できます。ひじ、ひざは二重関節になっており、広範囲な可動を再現しています。 帽子を被り、鋭くにらみを利かせているデュオ・マックスウェルのフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Death Scythe Hell, Gundam Death Scythe Hell, which was strengthened by the destroyed base, is reproduced in 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement, and the fingers are also movable, and the knees are double jointed. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, allowing you to reproduce the rotation of the hips. The two twin beam sized blades can be moved independently, and the stowed handle can be mounted on the rear armor at the waist. The blade at the tip of the new Buster Seal can be opened and closed, and the beam parts can also be attached and detached. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, and the waist can be twisted. The active cloak's deployment mechanism allows you to reproduce the action in the play without replacing it. The elbows and knees are double jointed, allowing for a wide range of movement. Includes a figure of Duo Maxwell wearing a hat and glaring sharply.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W エンドレスワルツ」に登場する５体のガンダムの1体「ウイングガンダムゼロ(エンドレスワルツ版)」を精巧な1/100スケールで再現しました 。カメラアイをクリアーパーツ、胸部サーチアイをジュエルシールで再現しています。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、広範囲な可動を実現しています 。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転が可能です。肩部マシンキャノンは展開が可能で、肩アーマーは３枚の装甲が独立可動します 。背面4枚の翼が独立可動し、内側の小翼は差し替え式で展開状態を再現できます 。ビーム・サーベルはクリアーパーツ製のビーム部分が取り外せ、柄は設定通り小翼基部に収納が可能です 。ツインバスターライフルは左右への合体分離が可能です 。背面部4枚の翼の可動、及び足首周辺パーツの可動により、大気圏突入形態の再現が可能です 。各翼には精巧なモールドを施し、劇中設定を超えた精密感を再現しています 。1/20スケールのヒイロ・ユイのフィギュアが付いています
phrases.en: "Wing Gundam Zero (Endless Waltz version)", one of the five Gundams that appear in "Mobile Suit Gundam W Endless Waltz", is reproduced in an elaborate 1/100 scale. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the chest search eye is reproduced with jewel seal. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to provide a wide range of movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, and the waist can be rotated. The shoulder machine cannon can be deployed, and the shoulder armor has three armor pieces that can move independently. The four wings on the back can move independently, and the small inner wings can be replaced to recreate the unfolded state. The beam saber's clear beam part can be removed, and the handle can be stored at the base of the small wing as specified. The Twin Buster Rifle can be combined and separated to the left and right. By moving the four wings on the back and moving the parts around the ankle, it is possible to reproduce the atmosphere entry form. Each wing has an elaborate mold, reproducing a sense of precision that goes beyond the setting in the play. Comes with a 1/20 scale Heero Yui figure.

An introductory version that is easy to assemble even for plastic model beginners. The new polycap "array joint" expands the range of motion and allows you to recreate cool animation poses. Using 4 colors (white, red, reddish brown, gray) of Elopla, we reproduce the setting colors of Gunner Zaku Warrior. It is equipped with a gun battle type backpack as a special exclusive weapon, and the barrel can be reproduced in two modes: bombardment and storage using the ribs.

Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, and newly designed polycaps are used for other joints. As a fighting action part, it comes with a torso with the shoulder axis tilted forward and the waist bent forward in order to reproduce the state of swinging Heat Shotel down. Heat Shotel can be used as a backpack by replacing the handle. In addition, it is possible to reproduce the cross crusher by attaching it to a special seal that did not appear in the movie.

phrases.en: Hazel Kai's HGUC series plastic model that appears in "Advance of Zeta". The back boost pod is movable and the sealed booster is also removable, realistically reproducing Hazel Kai's characteristic unit replacement. The weapon mount on the shoulder can be replaced and selected, and the grenade launcher equipped state can also be reproduced. The elbow joint uses a double joint, the first of its kind in HGUC. L-shaped joints are also used in the shoulders, further expanding the range of motion. Weapons include a beam rifle, a seal, a seal booster, and a beam saber. In addition, the rifle, seal, and backpack from the same series "HGUC Gundam Mk-II" can be attached.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」の劇中、OZの総帥トレーズクシュリナーダが開発したガンダムエピオンをリアルな1/144スケールモデルに再現しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動とともに、変形に必要なクリアランスを確保しています。前腕のクローが独立して可動します。背面ウイングは大きく可動し、変形に必要なクリアランスを確保しています。ヒートロッドは3箇所に可動部を設け、シールドへの着脱も可能です。他に、腰サイドアーマーにマウントできるビームソードの柄、手持ち用のビームソードが付いています。n手首を取り外し、腰リアアーマーを差し替える事で、ＭＡ形態への変形が可能です。 ホワイトファングの制服を身にまとったミリアルド・ピースクラフトのフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: The Gundam Epyon developed by OZ's commander Treys Kushrinada in the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam W" is reproduced in a realistic 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to ensure smooth movement and the necessary clearance for transformation. The claws on the forearm can move independently. The rear wing is movable and provides the necessary clearance for transformation. The heat rod has three movable parts and can be attached to and detached from the Seal. In addition, it comes with a beam sword handle that can be mounted on the waist side armor, and a beam sword for hand-held use. It can be transformed into MA form by removing the wrists and replacing the rear armor on the waist. Includes a Miliard Peacecraft figure wearing a White Fang uniform.

If you install HGUC RX-78-2 Gundam, you can recreate the famous scene from the first episode of "Mobile Suit Gundam". In addition to pursuing the existing details from the play, a special hanger with a new interpretation is included.

phrases.ja: ネオ・ドイツの科学力と正体不明の搭乗者、シュバルツ・ブルーダーの存在が各国のガンダムファイターを窮地に陥れた驚異の機体をキット化しました。前腕のシュピーゲルブレードが可動します。腰部アーマーはフロント、サイドがともに可動します。コアランダーは変形・合体ギミックに加え、上部スラスターの可動を再現しています。股関節と足首にボールジョイントを採用しています。
phrases.en: The scientific power of Neo-Germany and the existence of an unknown passenger, Schwarz Bruder, have turned into a kit the amazing aircraft that put Gundam fighters in various countries in a predicament. The Spiegel blade on the forearm is movable. Both the front and sides of the waist armor are movable. In addition to the deformation and combination gimmick, Corelander also reproduces the movement of the upper thruster. Ball joints are used at the hip joints and ankles.

phrases.ja: 機体エンブレムやナンバー等を再現する水転写式デカールが付属。

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」の物語後半に登場したガンダムデスサイズのパワーアップした機体、ガンダムデスサイズヘルが1/144スケールモデルでキット化。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現している他、指もそれぞれ可動し、またひざは二重関節になっています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転を再現できます。ツイン・ビーム・サイズの2本の刃はそれぞれ独立して可動し、収納状態の柄は腰リアアーマーにマウント出来ます。新型バスターシールドの先端部の刃の開閉も可能で、ビームパーツの着脱も出来ます。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰のひねりを実現しています。アクティブクロークの展開機構は、差し替えなしで劇中のアクションを再現できます。ひじ、ひざは二重関節になっており、広範囲な可動を再現しています。
phrases.en: Gundam Deathscythe Hell, a powered-up version of Gundam Deathscythe that appeared in the latter half of the story of "Mobile Suit Gundam W", has been made into a 1/144 Scale Model kit. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement, and the fingers are also movable, and the knees are double jointed. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, allowing you to reproduce the rotation of the hips. The two twin beam sized blades can be moved independently, and the stowed handle can be mounted on the rear armor at the waist. The blade at the tip of the new Buster Seal can be opened and closed, and the beam parts can also be attached and detached. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, and the waist can be twisted. The active cloak's deployment mechanism allows you to reproduce the action in the play without replacing it. The elbows and knees are double jointed, allowing for a wide range of movement.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」に登場するガンダムエピオンが1/144スケールモデルで登場です。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動とともに、変形に必要なクリアランスを確保しています。前腕のクローが独立して可動します。背面ウイングは大きく可動し、変形に必要なクリアランスを確保しています。ヒートロッドは3箇所に可動部を設け、シールドへの着脱も可能です。他に、腰サイドアーマーにマウントできるビームソードの柄、手持ち用のビームソードが付いています。n手首を取り外し、腰リアアーマーを差し替える事で、ＭＡ形態への変形が可能です。
phrases.en: Gundam Epyon that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam W" is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to ensure smooth movement and the necessary clearance for transformation. The claws on the forearm can move independently. The rear wing is movable and provides the necessary clearance for transformation. The heat rod has three movable parts and can be attached to and detached from the Seal. In addition, it comes with a beam sword handle that can be mounted on the waist side armor, and a beam sword for hand-held use. It can be transformed into MA form by removing the wrists and replacing the rear armor on the waist.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W エンドレスワルツ」に登場するガンダムデスサイズヘルカスタムを全身クリアーパーツとメッキパーツで再現した1/144スケールモデルの特別バージョンです。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用する他、その他の各関節部にも新設計のジョイントパーツを使用し、スムーズで広範囲な可動を実現しています。ビームシザースを大きく振り上げたポーズを再現するため、肩の軸を傾け、腰をひねった状態の胴体パーツがファイティング・アクション用パーツとして付いています。肩アーマーは後ハメが可能で、ブレードが独立して可動します。アクティブクローク中央に位置するバックパックの上下スイングが可能です。アクティブクロークの開閉は差し替え式で再現しています。劇中設定に新たな解釈を加え、美しい曲線と、精巧なモールドを配してあります。
phrases.en: A special version of the 1/144 Scale Model that reproduces the Gundam Death Scythe Hell Custom that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam W Endless Waltz" with full body clear parts and plated parts. In addition to using ball joints for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles, newly designed joint parts are used for each other joint to achieve smooth and wide range of movement. In order to reproduce the pose of swinging the beam scissors wide, torso parts with the shoulders tilted and hips twisted are included as fighting action parts. The shoulder armor can be attached to the back, and the blade can be moved independently. The backpack located in the center of the active cloakroom can be swung up and down. The opening and closing of the active cloak is reproduced with a replacement type. A new interpretation of the setting in the play, with beautiful curves and elaborate molds.

The deployment gimmick of the machine cannon from the shoulder to the torso can be reproduced without replacement. Using the included light emitting diode and 2 AA batteries (sold separately), you can reproduce the light emitting state of the energy multiplier. The field generator on the back unfolds. The five fingers of the hand can move independently, and a flat hand made of translucent soft resin is included for the explosive god finger. Corelander can be transformed and detached. The swing mechanism of the arm cover and the slide mechanism of the leg thruster are movable. Equipped with 2 God Slashes, blades made of clear parts are removable. In addition, the handle can be mounted on side armor.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア」のMSバリエーション「CCA-MSV」より“ニューガンダム（ヘビー・ウエポン・システム装備型）”がHGUCにラインナップ。ニューガンダムに追加装甲（胸部、フロント・リアアーマー、脚部大型スラスター）とハイパー・メガ・ライフル、ロケット砲を備えた大型シールドを装備したヘビー・ウエポン・システム装備を再現。胸部増加装甲上部のミサイルポッドは上下に可動。フィン・ファンネルは一枚ごとに分離、各関節部が可動。パーツの組み替えで、通常のニューガンダムも再現可能。ハイパー・メガ・ライフル、大型シールド、ビーム・ライフル、ハイパー・バズーカ、シールド、ビーム・サーベル（2種類）、フィン・ファンネル×6が付属。
phrases.en: "New Gundam (heavy weapon system equipped type)" from "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack" MS variation "CCA-MSV" is now available in HGUC. Reproduces the heavy weapon system equipment of the new Gundam, which is equipped with additional armor (chest, front and rear armor, large thrusters on the legs), a hyper mega rifle, and a large Seal with a rocket cannon. The missile pod at the top of the chest armor can move up and down. The fins and funnels can be separated one by one, and each joint can be moved. By rearranging the parts, you can also reproduce the regular new Gundam. Includes Hyper Mega Rifle, Large Seal, Beam Rifle, Hyper Bazooka, Seal, Beam Saber (2 types), and Fin Funnel x6.

phrases.ja: 良好なプロポーションと可動範囲を備え、組みやすさを実現した2015年発売の「ＨＧ 1/144 RX-78-2 ガンダム」の設計データを元に、色再現と組み立てやすさを両立し再構築。
phrases.en: Based on the design data of the 2015 release "HG 1/144 RX-78-2 Gundam", which has good proportions, a range of movement, and is easy to assemble, it has been rebuilt to achieve both color reproduction and ease of assembly.

phrases.ja: • 胴体の専用パーツを選択することで自然な座りポーズが表現可能。
phrases.en: • A natural sitting pose can be expressed by selecting special parts for the torso.

phrases.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム0083 STARDUST MEMORY』より、全身にクロムメッキコーティングを施した、スペシャルバージョンのキットです。1両肩のフレキシブルスラスターバインダーは、左右へ展開するのに連動し、スラスターが向きを変えます。長大な武器であるアトミックバズーカは分割でき、その砲身は大型のシールド内へ格納可能。核弾頭もバックパックコンテナ内へ格納できます。足部は外装を取り外すと、精巧に再現された内部機構が楽しめます。アトミックバズーカとシールド以外に、腰へ収納されているビームサーベルが2本付いています。/20スケールで再現された「アナベル・ガトー」の精悍なフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: A special version of the kit from "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 STARDUST MEMORY" with a chrome-plated coating on the entire body. The flexible thruster binders on both shoulders are linked to deploy left and right, and the thrusters change direction. The long weapon atomic bazooka can be divided into parts, and its barrel can be stored inside a large seal. Nuclear warheads can also be stored inside the backpack container. When you remove the exterior of the feet, you can enjoy the elaborately reproduced internal mechanism. In addition to the atomic bazooka and Seal, it also comes with two beam sabers stored on its waist. Comes with a fearless figure of "Annabelle Gato" reproduced in /20Scale.

phrases.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム0083 STARDUST MEMORY』より、白いブーストポッドが特徴的な宇宙装備を施された「ガンダムGP01-Fb」が、様々なギミックを盛り込んでMGシリーズでキット化。胴体へ水平格納されるコアブロックは、コアファイターIIへ完全変形可能です。肩のサブスラスターはスライドギミックを内蔵しており、差し換え無しでノズルの展開が楽しめます。つま先と踵のカバーが着脱可能。胸のノズルもパーツの組み換えにより、開閉を再現できます。ビームライフルはE-CAPの着脱が可能、伸縮機構を再現したシールドの裏には、予備のE-CAPが2つ備えられています。コアファイターIIのビームガンにもなるビームサーベルは2本、両肩へ装備されます。
phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam0083 STARDUST MEMORY", "GundamGP01-Fb", which is equipped with space equipment with a distinctive white boost pod, has been made into a kit in the MG series with various gimmicks. The core block stored horizontally in the fuselage can be completely transformed into Core Fighter II. The shoulder sub-thruster has a built-in slide gimmick, so you can enjoy deploying the nozzle without having to replace it. Removable toe and heel covers. The opening and closing of the nozzle on the chest can also be recreated by rearranging the parts. The beam rifle has a removable E-CAP, and there are two spare E-CAPs on the back of the seal that reproduces the expansion and contraction mechanism. Two beam sabers, which can also be used as Core Fighter II's beam guns, are equipped on both shoulders.

The rear thruster of the fighter nose is movable. By sliding the head unit, mobile suit/fighter mode transformations can be reproduced without replacement. Plated parts are used for the head antenna and chest mechanical details. It comes with two buster rifles, a booster beam cannon, and a missile rifle. Comes with foil seal.

phrases.en: Among the neo-Zeon army new type mobile suits that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack," the model that was dedicated to Quess Paraya was made into a kit. Comes with a beam gatling gun, beam assault rifle, beam saber, and seal. The fingers are movable. Screw fastening mechanisms are used on the forearms, thighs, and torso. All waist armor can be moved independently. The seals on both shoulders are movable, and the 6 funnels are removable.

phrases.en: Among the neo-Zeon new type mobile suits that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack", the model that was dedicated to Gyunei Gas is made into a kit. Equipped with a beam assault rifle, beam saber, and Seal. The fingers are movable. A screw mechanism is used to secure the forearms, thighs, and torso. The characteristic head face guard is molded as a separate part. All waist armor can be moved independently. The seals on both shoulders are movable, and 6 funnels can be attached and detached.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム0083 STARDUST MEMORY」より、全身にクロムメッキコーティングを施した、スペシャルバージョンのキットです。胴体へ水平格納されるコアブロックは、コアファイターIIへ完全変形可能です。肩のサブスラスターはスライドギミックを内蔵しており、差し換え無しでノズルの展開が楽しめます。つま先と踵のカバーが着脱可能。胸のノズルもパーツの組み換えにより、開閉を再現できます。ビームライフルはE-CAPの着脱が可能、伸縮機構を再現したシールドの裏には、予備のE-CAPが2つ備えられています。コアファイターIIのビームガンにもなるビームサーベルは2本、両肩へ装備されます。1/20スケールで再現された「コウ・ウラキ」の精悍なフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: A special version of the kit from "Mobile Suit Gundam0083 STARDUST MEMORY" with a chrome-plated coating on the entire body. The core block stored horizontally in the fuselage can be completely transformed into Core Fighter II. The shoulder sub-thruster has a built-in slide gimmick, so you can enjoy deploying the nozzle without having to replace it. Removable toe and heel covers. The opening and closing of the nozzle on the chest can also be recreated by rearranging the parts. The beam rifle has a removable E-CAP, and there are two spare E-CAPs on the back of the seal that reproduces the expansion and contraction mechanism. Two beam sabers, which can also be used as Core Fighter II's beam guns, are equipped on both shoulders. Comes with a fearless figure of "Kou Uraki" reproduced in 1/20 scale.

phrases.ja: OVA「機動戦士ガンダム0083」に登場する「ザクF2」の連邦軍バージョンのプラモデル。1年戦争終結後、連邦軍により使用され続けた機体をマスターグレードならではのディティールでキット化しました。肩の関節は基部を胴体より引き出す様になっており、より広範囲の可動が可能になりました。足部には内部構造が再現されています。外装を外すと中の精密なメカディティールを楽しむ事が出来ます。頭部のモノアイが左右へ可動します。頭部にはアップリケアーマーを接着し、ディテールアップする事が可能です。ザクの持つ象徴的な武器のである、 120mmマシンガンとヒートホーク、280mmバズーカに加え、シュツルムファウストとハンドグレネードが付きます。
phrases.en: A plastic model of the Federation Forces version of the "Zaku F2" that appears in the OVA "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083". After the end of the 1st war, the aircraft that continued to be used by the Federal Army has been turned into a kit with details unique to Master Grade. The base of the shoulder joint is pulled out from the body, allowing for a wider range of movement. The internal structure of the feet is reproduced. By removing the exterior, you can enjoy the precise mechanical details inside. The mono-eye on the head can move left and right. Appliqué armor can be attached to the head to add more detail. In addition to the Zaku's iconic weapons, a 120mm machine gun, heat hawk, and 280mm bazooka, it also comes with a Sturmfaust and a hand grenade.

The left and right twin dragon hangs can be expanded without replacement. The fingers are movable. The beam cannon and wings on the random binder on the back can be flexibly moved. Weapons include twin beam trident and Shenron Seal. Shenron Seal can be attached to and removed from the left shoulder armor.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム SEED」の主人公機「ストライクガンダム」が1/60スケールのビックサイズモデルでのキット化です。ポイントディテールアップを別パーツで色分けする事により、精密なディテールを再現しています。両手首の指は全て可動式です。コクピットハッチが開閉でき、内部には同スケールのパイロット「キラ・ヤマト」のフィギュアが再現されています。肩の付け根が前後にスイング可動、また足首の関節も二重関節となっており安定性を確保しているので、様々なポージングが可能です。両腰のアーマーには、開閉可能なハッチのなかにコンバットナイフ「アーマーシュナイダー」を格納できます。細部までディテールが再現されたビーム・ライフルとシールド、アーマーシュナイダー2本が武器として装備可能です。アーマーシュナイダーは折り畳み機構が再現されています。
phrases.en: The main character "Strike Gundam" from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" has been made into a 1/60 Scale big size model kit. By color-coding the point detail up with separate parts, precise details are reproduced. All fingers on both wrists are movable. The cockpit hatch can be opened and closed, and the figure of the same Scale pilot "Kira Yamato" is reproduced inside. The base of the shoulders can be swung back and forth, and the ankle joints are double jointed to ensure stability, allowing for a variety of poses. The combat knife "Armor Schneider" can be stored in the hatches on both hips that can be opened and closed. A beam rifle, a Seal, and two Armor Schneiders can be equipped as weapons, with detailed reproductions. Armor Schneider's folding mechanism has been reproduced.

phrases.ja: ●風龍、雷龍の特徴的な形状やカラーリングを徹底再現　新規造形を交えて風龍、雷龍を立体化。成形色でのパーツ色分けを実現。　それぞれを象徴する、風龍のジャオダンジィ・雷龍のデンジャンホーも徹底再現。　細部にわたるこだわりの色再現、プラスチックシールとホイルシールの採用により全身の細かな色分けを再現。●幅広い可動で劇中の動きを再現できる可動性能を追求　雷龍の専用武器、エレキガンも付属。　ジャオダンジィは一部パーツの差し替えと軸可動で劇中のような担ぐポージングを再現できる。　雷龍はジョイントパーツを用いる事でデンジャンホーに乗ることが可能。●システムチェンジによりロボットモードからビークルモードへ変形！　一部パーツの差し替えで、ビークルを再現可能。●シンメトリカルドッキング！撃龍神登場！！●印象的な必殺技シーンを再現可能！●別売りのHG超竜神（「氷竜」「炎龍」）との組み換えにより、「幻竜神」「強龍神」を再現可能。
phrases.en: -Thoroughly reproduce the characteristic shapes and coloring of Wind Dragon and Thunder Dragon.Furyu and Thunder Dragon are now three-dimensional with new modeling. Realizes color-coding of parts by molding color. The Wind Dragon's Jiaodanji and the Thunder Dragon's Dengjanho, which symbolize each, are also thoroughly reproduced. The detailed color reproduction and the use of plastic seals and foil seals reproduce the detailed coloring of the entire body. - Pursuing movable performance that can reproduce the movements in the play with a wide range of movement - Rairyu's special weapon, electric gun, is also included. The Gerbera Straight weapon is plated on both sides and has a ripple pattern for even more realism. Also included are a beam saber, beam rifle, Sealdo, 1/20 scale Law Gule, and Hachi figures.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW」に登場する5体のガンダムの1体、シェンロンガンダムが1/100スケールモデルでモデル化しました。頭部アンテナなど各部にゴールドメッキパーツを使用しています。首、手首、股関節、足首にはボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部装甲と胴体が別パーツになっており、腰の回転が可能な他、腰アーマーはフロント部、サイド部が可動します。カメラアイをクリアーパーツで再現し、両肩アーマーのファイティングサイトをジュエルシールで再現しています。右手首のドラゴンハングは、手首を取り外して展開機構を再現しています。ドラゴンハングは基部のみでなく、クロー部も可動します。ビームグレイブのビーム部分はクリアーパーツで再現されており、着脱が可能です。柄は背部の専用ラックへ着脱が可能です。ドラゴンハングへ着脱可能なクリアーパーツ製のイメージアップパーツが付いています。
phrases.en: Shenron Gundam, one of the five Gundams appearing in "Mobile Suit GundamW", has been made into a 1/100 Scale Model. Gold-plated parts are used for each part such as the head antenna. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest armor and torso are separate parts, and the waist can rotate, and the front and side parts of the waist armor can be moved. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the fighting sights on both shoulder armor are reproduced with jewel seals. The dragon hang on the right wrist reproduces the deployment mechanism by removing the wrist. Not only the base of the dragon hang, but also the claw part can be moved. The beam part of Beam Grave is reproduced with clear parts and can be attached and detached. The handle can be attached to and removed from the special rack on the back. Comes with image-enhancing parts made of clear parts that can be attached to and removed from the dragon hang.
