phrases.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム0083』に登場した大型モビルアーマー、ノイエ・ジールをキット化しました。一度見たら忘れられない斬新な外観をあますところなく立 体上に再現。装甲裏面の複雑なディテールもパーツ分けにより、こだわりをもって再現しました。劇中最後に登場したあの「隠し腕」は設定どおり４本を再現 し、ビーム・サーベルの取りつけも可能にしています。メインアームにはリード線を使用して有線コントロールアームの設定を生かしてあります。同スケール 1/550のガンダムGP03SとザクF2が付いています。ノイエ・ジール本体のディスプレイ台にはジオンの紋章が付き、作品世界を印象付けています。
phrases.en: The large mobile armor that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083", Neue Zeal, has been made into a kit. The innovative appearance that you will never forget once you see it is perfectly reproduced in three dimensions. The intricate details on the back of the armor have been carefully reproduced by dividing the parts into parts. The four "hidden arms" that appeared at the end of the play have been reproduced as planned, and a beam saber can also be attached. The main arm uses a lead wire to take advantage of the wired control arm setting. Comes with the same scale 1/550 GundamGP03S and Zaku F2. The Zeon emblem is attached to the display stand of Neue Zeer itself, giving an impression of the world of the work.

phrases.en: The largest new type mobile armor in the history of the Neo Zeon army that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack" has been dynamically turned into a kit. It comes with the same Scale 1/550 size ν Gundam and a display stand, creating a sense of scale and collectability. The deformation gimmick that stores the head into the body is reproduced, making it possible to transform into the landing position without replacing parts. The extension and contraction mechanism of the front and rear landing (descent) arms has been reproduced. The triple beam cannon is movable, and the mega arm cannon also has a rotating body. The unfolding and retracting mechanism of the hidden arm is reproduced as set. Front armor and rear skirt are movable. The propellant tank is movable. The large funnel is mounted on the rear skirt.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム／第08ＭＳ小隊」に登場する"ボール"のＭＧ仕様プラモデル。二連装マシンキャノンの銃身は、先端部をスライドにより開口し、肉薄での精密感を追求しました。センサー部分はクリアーパーツを使用しています。可動アーム基部の関節カバーなどに軟質パーツを、ダンパー部に金属シャフトを、アーム先端には極細のリード線を使用し、リアルな質感を再現しています。ウインチワイヤー部は軟質素材で精密再現、アンカーは発射時の形状と展開時の２種が付属します。標準タイプのキャノン砲も付属し、交換が可能です。
phrases.en: MG specification plastic model of "Ball" that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam/08th MS Platoon". The barrel of the dual machine cannon has a sliding opening at the tip to pursue a thin and precise feel. The sensor part uses clear parts. Soft parts are used for the joint cover at the base of the movable arm, a metal shaft is used for the damper, and ultra-thin lead wire is used at the tip of the arm to reproduce a realistic texture. The winch wire part is precisely reproduced with soft material, and the anchor comes in two types: one when launched and one when deployed. A standard type cannon is also included and can be replaced.

phrases.en: From the popular series "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 Stardust Memory", "RX-78 GP-02A Gundam Prototype Unit 2" is now available in the HGUC series. By pursuing the range of motion, it is possible to reproduce the flying form with the binders on both shoulders deployed. The atomic bazooka reproduces the gimmick that connects the base of the right shoulder and the gun barrel stored in the seal, and can also be held in flying form. By pursuing the shape of the wrist and elbow joint, the arm can hold the bazooka in a natural form. By replacing the joint parts that connect the included display stand and the main body, you can recreate the confrontation scene with Gundam GP01Fb.

phrases.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム』で暗い森の中を疾走しながら登場した、ジオン公国軍の量産型重モビルスーツ「ドム」が迫力のボリュームでキット化です。重量感あふれるプロポーションの内部には、細密なメカディティールが再現されており、外装を取り外すことで見ることができます。厚みのある外装は2重構造となっており、内側にはリアルなモールドを細密に再現しています。指は第2関節まで曲げる事が可能で、ジャイアントバズーカなどの大型武器もしっかりと保持できます。武器は、ジャイアントバズーカ、ヒートサーベル、ラケーテンバズ、90mmマシンガン、予備マガジン、シュツルムファウストが付いています。1/20スケールのオルテガのフィギュアも付いています。
phrases.en: The Zeon Principality Army's mass-produced heavy mobile suit "Dom", which appeared running through the dark forest in "Mobile Suit Gundam", has been made into a kit with impressive volume. The interior has heavy proportions, and minute mechanical details have been reproduced, which can be seen by removing the exterior. The thick exterior has a double layered structure, and the inside has a detailed reproduction of a realistic mold. The fingers can be bent up to the second joint, making it possible to firmly hold large weapons such as a giant bazooka. Weapons include a giant bazooka, heat saber, Raketenbuzz, 90mm machine gun, spare magazine, and Sturmfaust. A 1/20 Scale Ortega figure is also included.

The Gatling gun can be attached to and removed from the left arm by replacing it with the wrist, and can also be mounted on a backpack.

phrases.en: A kit of an experimental aircraft developed from the Zeon Army J-type Zaku for underwater warfare. The arms can swing back and forth. The hip joint opens and closes to the left and right. The wrist parts include left and right hand grips, a flat hand, and a hand grip for holding the sub-rock gun. The chest rocket pod, right shoulder underwater radar unit, and elbow/knee seals can be installed selectively. Comes with 2 rocket pods. The special decal includes two types, normal specification and Red Dolphin Corps specification, and is selectable.

phrases.ja: セガサターン用ゲームソフト「機動戦士ガンダム外伝III 裁かれし者」に登場したMS“ブルーディスティニー2号機”がHGUCシリーズにラインナップ。股関軸の可動により自然な膝立ちポーズが可能。肩の可動軸は前後上下に可動、リアルな射撃シーンを再現。スネの外側にあるサーベル・ラックは、パーツの付け替えで展開、内部メカディテールも再現。機体各部のマーキングを再現するシールが付属。ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベル×2、シールドが付属。
phrases.en: The MS “Blue Destiny Unit 2” that appeared in the Sega Saturn game “Mobile Suit Gundam Gaiden III: The Judged” is now available in the HGUC series. phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム００８３」に登場した主役メカながらも、その巨大スケールゆえにファンの要望を満たす形でのキット化は難しいと言われていたデンドロビウムを、1/550サイズでついにキット化しました。本機収納状態のステイメンと、飛行形態のガーベラ・テトラが付いています。コンテナハッチは開閉選択式で動きを持たせた作りになっています。後部バーニアは、スペースシャトルなど現実世界のデザインを思わせるディテールを精密に構築してリアリティを高めています。メガビーム砲のコントロールグリップとアイ･フィールド・ジェネレータもそれぞれ開閉選択式です。下部大型クロー（爪）は、差替えパーツで展開・収納状態を再現しました。展開パーツは可動します。本機とガーベラ・テトラのそれぞれに専用ディスプレイスタンドが付いています。
phrases.en: Although Dendrobium is a main character mechanism that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083", it was said that it would be difficult to make it into a kit in a way that satisfies the demands of fans due to its huge scale, but we have finally made it into a kit in 1/550 size. Comes with Staymen in its stored state and Gerbera Tetra in flight form. The container hatch can be opened or closed, giving it movement. The rear vernier has been precisely constructed with details reminiscent of real-world designs such as the Space Shuttle to enhance realism. The control grip of the mega beam cannon and the eye field generator can also be opened or closed. The lower large claw can be recreated in its unfolded and stored state with replacement parts. Deployment parts are movable. This unit and Gerbera Tetra each come with a dedicated display stand.

phrases.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム SEED DESTINY」に登場するグフイグナイテッド（量産機カラー）のHGシリーズ1/144スケールのプラモデルです。専用ソードは、シールドに収納可能な短剣タイプと、ビーム刃を取り付け可能な延長タイプの２タイプを付属しています。フライングイメージを再現できる専用台座も付属。ヒートロッドの攻撃状態をクリアタイプにてリアルに再現しています。
phrases.en: A plastic model of the HG series 1/144 Scale of Gouf Ignited (mass production machine color) that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY". The special sword comes with two types: a dagger type that can be stored in the seal, and an extension type that can attach a beam blade. A special pedestal is also included to recreate the flying image. The attack state of the heat rod is realistically reproduced in clear type.

phrases.ja: • ガンプラの中で最大サイズ。幅広いユーザーさまへのストレスフリー構造。• 全身34ヶ所の可動により自由なポージングが 可能。• 大型モデルの重量を支える為、ポリキャップにクリック機構を付加。• ランナーからパーツをはずしやすい『くさびゲート』を使用。• カラーシールなしで完全カラー再現。頭部は完全色分けを実現。• パーツの組み間違いを減らし、より組立てやすくするためランナーロックを採用。• 『パーツセパレータ』と『ゲートセパレータ』が1つになったダブルセパレータが付属。• パーツ裏側にパーツ番号表記• 「月刊ホビージャパン」「月刊電撃ホビーマガジン」編集のハウトゥ記事を掲載した小冊子を同梱。
phrases.en: • Largest size among Gunpla. Stress-free structure for a wide range of users. • 34 movable parts of the whole body allow for free posing. • Added a click mechanism to the polycap to support the weight of large models. • Uses a "wedge gate" that makes it easy to remove parts from the Runner. • Full color reproduction without color seals. The head is completely color coded. • Runner lock is used to reduce parts assembly errors and make assembly easier. • Comes with a double separator that combines a "parts separator" and a "gate separator" into one. • Part numbers are written on the back of the parts • A booklet containing how-to articles edited by Hobby Japan and Dengeki Hobby Magazine is included.

The black triple star specification aircraft color is reproduced with molding color. You can recreate a shoulder tackle by rotating your hips and bending your upper body forward. The elbow has a newly adopted double joint that expands the range of motion. Includes Zaku Bazooka, Shoulder Bazooka Rack, 105mm Zaku Machine Gun, Heat Hawk, Sturmfaust, and Knuckle Seal. Comes with a special marking seal of black triple stars.

Posing performance has been improved by changing the waist parts! The range of motion is increased by changing the leg parts! • Reproduce the transformation to Unicorn mode and Destroy mode! A fixed antenna exclusively for Destroy mode has been added, and comes in three types: open/close, closed, and open! Extra finish specification with plating applied to the whole body that brings back the impact of PHASE 34 "Nightmare". It is possible to reproduce the Heimat full burst shown in the movie. Using the included sword silhouette, it is possible to reproduce the strongest equipment used when defeating Freedom Gundam.

The opening and closing mechanism of the breast gatling and shoulder missile hatch on the shoulder armor can be reproduced. The inner arm gatling can be stored inside by removing the left wrist part. phrases.en: A masterpiece that inherits the genealogy of Gelgoog, now available as HGUC! From "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", Rigelgu appears in the HGUC series! The characteristic aircraft shape and weapons that inherit the Gelgoog lineage are reproduced with new modeling! ● Thoroughly reproduces the body shape of Rigelgu with new modeling! ・The details of the head antenna, which is characteristic of the head, are reproduced with new modeling. ・Shoulder armor The wing binder, which is more than twice as long as the conventional Gelgoog, is reproduced with a new model. Inside, there are 3 verniers built into each shoulder. - Reproduce the arm and forearm armor with new modeling. It is possible to reproduce the shutter opening and closing state of the arm grenade launcher, which is an additional weapon. - Characteristic shapes, including the backpack missile pod and propellant tank, are reproduced with new modeling. The missile pod can reproduce the hatch opening and closing state. ● Beam Lancer and special beam rifle are included with new modeling. Beam Lancer can be suspended at the bottom of the backpack as configured. Attached weapons: Dedicated beam rifle/beam lancer/beam rifle 1/144 Scale Assembly type plastic model Target age: 8 years old or older Product material: PS, PE, ABS, no adhesive is used for the assembly. *The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product. (Note) - This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects, or overseas.・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person. note that. - Shipping of this product may change depending on the application status and production circumstances. Thank you for your understanding.・Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product. - Product specifications are scheduled as of 20184. Please note that there may be changes.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場する5体のガンダムの1体、ガンダムデスサイズヘルカスタムが1/100スケールモデルでキット化しました。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰のひねりが可能になっています。腰アーマーはフロントとサイドの他に、ブロック正面の装甲も可動します。肩アーマー及びひざアーマーのブレードは、それぞれアーマーと独立して可動します。アクティブクローク先端のブレードは、アクティブクローク本体と独立して可動し、アクティブクローク閉鎖状態でも左右で干渉する事はありません。ビームシザースはクリアー成型の刃部分が着脱可能です。機体各部のブレードが可動する事により、アクティブクロークとの干渉を避け、一切の差し替えなしで展開機構の再現を可能にしました。アクティブクロークは、複雑な曲面構造を一体成型で再現し、強度的な不安なく、美しくディスプレイできます。デュオ・マックスウェルの1/20スケールフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: Gundam Death Scythe Hell Custom, one of the five Gundams appearing in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz", has been made into a kit with 1/100 Scale Model. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, making it possible to twist the waist. In addition to the front and side waist armor, the armor on the front of the block is also movable. The blades of the shoulder armor and knee armor move independently of the armor. The blade at the tip of the active cloak moves independently from the active cloak body, and there is no interference between the left and right sides even when the active cloak is closed. The clear molded blade part of the beam scissors is removable. By moving the blades of each part of the aircraft, it avoids interference with the active cloak, making it possible to reproduce the deployment mechanism without any replacements. Active Cloak reproduces a complex curved structure in one piece, allowing you to display it beautifully without worrying about its strength. Comes with a 1/20 Scale figure of Duo Maxwell.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW」シリーズ最大の1/60スケールでウイングガンダムゼロを再現しました。首、手首他、各部にボールジョイントを使用し、フレキシブルな可動を再現しています。胸部サーチアイ部に内蔵されているの発光ダイオードは単4電池2本（別売）を使用し、発光させる事が可能です。全ての指は独立して可動し、親指以外は第二間接まで可動します。マシンキャノン、胸部左右ダクトハッチ、肩アーマーサーベルラックは開閉可能です。背面ウイングバーニアの左右カバーは連動・開閉を再現しています。ふくらはぎのカバー、かかとのバーニアは、展開機構を再現、可動します。ひじ、ひざはそれぞれ二重関節になっており、広範囲の可動を実現しています。左右の分離・合体が可能なツインバスターライフルは、グリップの収納もまで再現されています。シールドの伸縮機構も差し替えなしで再現できます。パーツの差し替えなしでネオバード形態への変形が可能です。ウイングバーニアの展開や、足首周りのパーツ可動機構により、より精密にネオバード形態を再現しています。ツインバスターライフルは機首シールドの左右へ装着できます。
phrases.en: Reproduce Wing Gundam Zero at 1/60 Scale, the largest in the "New Mobile Report GundamW" series. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, and other parts to reproduce flexible movement. The light emitting diode built into the chest search eye can be lit using two AAA batteries (sold separately). All fingers can move independently, and all but the thumb can move up to the second joint. Machine cannon, chest left and right duct hatches, and shoulder armor saber racks can be opened and closed. The left and right covers of the rear wing vernier reproduce interlocking and opening/closing. The calf cover and heel vernier reproduce the deployment mechanism and are movable. The elbows and knees are each double jointed, allowing for a wide range of movement. The Twin Buster Rifle can be separated and combined on the left and right sides, and even the storage of the grip has been reproduced. The expansion and contraction mechanism of Seal can also be reproduced without replacement. Can be transformed into Neobird form without replacing parts. By deploying the wing vernier and moving parts around the ankle, the Neobird form is more precisely reproduced. The twin buster rifle can be attached to the left and right sides of the nose seal.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」物語終盤に登場したトールギスIIが1/144スケールモデルでキット化。勇ましい騎士を彷彿とさせる頭部は細部ディテールまで再現されています。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現しています。胸部と腹部は別パーツになっており、腰の回転が可能な他、サイドの腰アーマーが可動します。両肩アーマーに取り付けるブースターは、劇中通りの展開機構を再現しています。肩アーマーの左右には、それぞれドーバーガンとシールドをマウントするラッチを装備しています。また、両装備は手に持たせる事も可能です。他にビームサーベルが付いています。
phrases.en: Tallgeese II, which appeared at the end of the "Mobile Suit Gundam W" story, is now a 1/144 Scale Model kit. The head, reminiscent of a brave knight, has been reproduced down to the finest detail. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, the waist can be rotated, and the side waist armor can be moved. The boosters attached to both shoulder armor reproduce the deployment mechanism as seen in the movie. The left and right sides of the shoulder armor are equipped with latches to mount the Dover Gun and Seal respectively. Also, both equipment can be held in the hand. Also comes with a beam saber.

phrases.en: Gundam Nataku, one of the five Gundams appearing in "Mobile Suit GundamW Endless Waltz", is now available as a 1/100 Scale Model with realistic details. Ball joints are used for the neck, hips, and ankles, and some of the leg parts are borrowed from Shenron Gundam. The waist can be rotated, and the front and side parts of the waist armor can be moved. The camera eye is reproduced with clear parts, and the beam part of the twin beam trident is also made of clear parts. The Dragon Hang can be expanded without replacing parts, and the arm uses multiple joints that allow it to move for each block. The tip of the dragon hang can be opened and closed on the left and right. Comes with a 1/20 scale Zhang Wufei figure.

The Riga Militia mobile suit comes with a multiple launcher, beam pistol, beam rifle, beam bazooka, and two side armor pieces. Exclusive to V2Gundam, it comes with two side armor-mounted beam guns and a sniping unit head. Zanskar's mobile suit comes with a multi-bazooka, beam bazooka, and gatling gun. There is one beam cannon on each side for Zanskar's Zoroat. Common parts include a flat hand, a grip hand, and two grips for holding the gun on each side. It comes with marking seals such as unit insignia and aircraft number.

By replacing the wrist parts and nose parts, it is possible to transform the upper body unit into a top fighter. The core fighter is included as a separate unit, and can be transformed into a bottom fighter using the legs and replacement parts. The main booster on the back and the rear armor booster on the waist can be opened and closed. The base of the beam and seal is molded with clear parts and can be moved. Comes with a beam rifle and two types of beam sabers. The fingers are movable.

The hem of the flared leg skirt is made into a separate part, and can be attached and removed by attaching it to the inner frame.The Seal has a new mount arm, reproducing the transition action from being attached to the back to being equipped on the arm.The waist skirt can be moved independently on the front, sides, and back.The head mono-eye reproduces the movement of the line of sight in conjunction with the swing of the head.Equipments such as a special beam rifle, beam naginata, and a special Seal are included. In addition to figures of Char Aznable (standing and seated) and Lalah Sun of the same scale, an electric car is included.

phrases.en: HG series plastic model of the Murasame mass-produced machine that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY". Includes a large missile to create an attack scene and a numbered seal to remind you of a formation with multiple aircraft. Smooth transformation is possible by replacing some parts using polycaps. Also included are tires that realistically reproduce the configuration during takeoff and landing. By connecting the crotch polycap to the included HG series dedicated pedestal, flight conditions such as diagonal flight and inverted flight can be reproduced.

phrases.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム0083 STARDUST MEMORY』より、デラーズフリートに奪われた戦術型モビルスーツ「ガンダムGP02A」を、重量感溢れるプロポーションに大胆なギミックアクションを加えてキット化しました。両肩のフレキシブルスラスターバインダーは、左右へ展開するのに連動し、スラスターが向きを変えます。長大な武器であるアトミックバズーカは分割でき、その砲身は大型のシールド内へ格納可能。核弾頭もバックパックコンテナ内へ格納できます。足部は外装を取り外すと、精巧に再現された内部機構が楽しめます。アトミックバズーカとシールド以外に、腰へ収納されているビームサーベルが2本付いています。
phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam0083 STARDUST MEMORY", the tactical mobile suit "GundamGP02A" stolen by Delaz Fleet has been made into a kit with heavy proportions and bold gimmick action. The flexible thruster binders on both shoulders are linked as they unfold to the left and right, and the thrusters change direction. The long weapon atomic bazooka can be divided into parts, and its barrel can be stored inside a large seal. Nuclear warheads can also be stored inside the backpack container. When you remove the exterior of the feet, you can enjoy the elaborately reproduced internal mechanism. In addition to the atomic bazooka and Seal, it also comes with two beam sabers stored on its waist.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」の主役機であるガンダムの1体が1/144スケールモデルで登場。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを採用し、可動範囲を広めています。また胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転も可能です。腰アーマーの、フロント部とサイド部が可動します。背部ウイングの左右スイングと、展開が可能です。ヒザは三重関節になっています。武器はシールドとバスターライフル、ビームサーベルが付いています。手首を取り外してバード形態への変形が可能です。
phrases.en: One of the main Gundam machines from "Mobile Suit Gundam W" is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles to widen the range of motion. Also, the chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, and the hips can be rotated. The front and side parts of the waist armor are movable. It is possible to swing the back wing left and right and deploy it. The knees are triple jointed. Weapons include a seal, a buster rifle, and a beam saber. It is possible to transform into bird form by removing the wrists.

phrases.ja: 劇場版「機動戦士Ｚガンダム 星を継ぐ者」でも大活躍のガンダム Mk-IIのＭＧ（マスターグレード）プラモデルが"Ver.2.0"にバージョンアップして登場。足首とスネアーマーなどに、最新の装甲連動型可動アクション方式を各部に採用。股関節の軸位置アジャスト機構により、劇中などの激しいアクションポーズも再現可能。バルカンポッド、バズーカ、ライフル、シールドなど各種武装が付属。シールドの伸縮機構再現、ライフル、バズーカの弾倉は着脱可能。ＭＳカタパルトを再現したディスプレイスタンドが付属。
phrases.en: The MG (master grade) plastic model of Gundam Mk-II, which played a big role in the movie "Mobile Suit Z Gundam: Heir to the Stars", has been updated to "Ver. 2.0" and is now available. The latest armor-linked movable action system is used in each part, such as the ankle and snare armor. The hip joint axis position adjustment mechanism allows you to recreate intense action poses from the movie. Includes various weapons such as Vulcan pod, bazooka, rifle, and Seal. Seal's telescopic mechanism is reproduced, and the rifle and bazooka magazines are removable. A display stand that reproduces the MS catapult is included.

phrases.ja: 全長315mmの機体は、下部カーゴ内にHGUC RX-78-2 ガンダム1体を格納可能にしました。航空機としてのディテールを追求することで、モビルスーツとは異なる存在感を打ち出しています。大型ミサイル6基は、カタパルトを使用してコンテナ内に装備可能です。
phrases.en: The aircraft has a total length of 315mm and can store one HGUC RX-78-2 Gundam in the lower cargo. By pursuing the details of an aircraft, it has a presence different from that of a mobile suit. Six large missiles can be equipped inside the container using a catapult.

By replacing some parts, you can recreate the transformation into mobile form and tank form. The ground surface of the caterpillar is textured to reproduce a detailed mold with emphasis on ease of assembly. The two shovel arms are movable flexibly, just like in the movie. The main gun's ejector device is reproduced down to the smallest detail. Includes 4 deck sailor and 1 pilot figures in 1/144 size.

phrases.en: The variable attack mobile suit developed in Universal Century 0087 with the aim of becoming the strongest aircraft has been made into a big size kit. The aircraft's biggest feature, the transformation, merging, and separation into "G Fortress", is completely reproduced. In addition to the completely transformable Core Fighter, a non-transformable Core Block is also included, allowing you to display Double Zeta Gundam and Core Fighter at the same time. The nose of the "G Fortress" has been modified to include a double beam rifle and two hyper beam sabers.

phrases.en: To commemorate the 20th anniversary of "Mobile Suit Gundam", a special kit with chrome plating applied to the entire body. The core fighter can be transformed into a core block and stored inside the fuselage. It also comes with a non-deformable core block, allowing Gundam and Core Fighter to be displayed at the same time. The markings on both shoulders are reproduced with special printing. Weapons include a beam rifle that can be mounted on the waist, two beam sabers stored in the backpack, a hyper bazooka, and a seal with a mold on the back. Comes with a fearless figure of "Amuro Ray" reproduced in 1/20 scale.

phrases.en: A kit version of the general-purpose mass-produced mobile suit of the Neo Zeon army that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack." I use screws for the shank and torso. The right shoulder seal is movable. Seal can be attached to the left forearm, reproduces the folding mechanism, and can store the four included Sturmfausts inside. phrases.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Tallgeese II, the blue Tallgeese piloted by Treize Kushrinada during the decisive battle with White Fang, is reproduced in 1/144 Scale Model. The head, reminiscent of a brave knight, has been reproduced down to the finest detail. Ball joints are used in the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement. The chest and abdomen are separate parts, the waist can be rotated, and the side waist armor can be moved. The boosters attached to both shoulder armor reproduce the deployment mechanism as seen in the movie. The left and right sides of the shoulder armor are equipped with latches to mount the Dover Gun and Seal respectively. Also, both equipment can be held in the hand. Also comes with a beam saber. Includes a figure of Treize Kushrinada dressed in military uniform reminiscent of a medieval knight.

The internal mechanisms are reproduced in the torso, arms, and legs, and the exterior can be removed and viewed after completion. The power pipe inside the shin uses a mesh pipe to reproduce the texture. In addition to the Zeon army's first equipment, the beam rifle, beam naginata, and Seal, it also comes with a backpack for the B type.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」に登場するデュオ・マックスウェルが搭乗するガンダムデスサイズが1/144スケールモデルで登場。首、手首、股関節、足首にボールジョイントを使用し、スムーズな可動を実現している他、指もそれぞれ可動し、またひざは二重関節になっています。胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、腰の回転を再現できます。収納状態のビーム・サイズは、腰リアアーマーにマウント可能で、展開状態ではビーム発生部が可動します。バスターシールドは刃の開閉が可能で、先端部にビームパーツを取り付けることも出来ます。オープニングに登場する時のポーズを再現したデュオのフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: Gundam Deathscythe, piloted by Duo Maxwell from "Mobile Suit Gundam W", is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hips, and ankles for smooth movement, and the fingers are also movable, and the knees are double jointed. The chest and abdomen are made into separate parts, allowing you to reproduce the rotation of the hips. The beam size in the stored state can be mounted on the rear armor at the waist, and the beam generating part can be moved in the expanded state. Buster Seal's blade can be opened and closed, and beam parts can be attached to the tip. Comes with a duo figure that recreates the pose they appeared in at the opening.

phrases.ja: • 胸部にはホビーディビジョンとして初の「コアバック成形」を採用！「コアバック成形」とは、多色成形の工程中に金型内が可動変形することで樹脂の流れる箇所を制御し、色の異なる樹脂が組み合わさった１つのパーツを成形する技術。これにより、複雑な色分けと組み立てやすさを両立！
phrases.en: • The chest uses "core back molding" for the first time in the hobby division! "Core-back molding" is a technology that controls the flow of resin by moving and deforming the inside of the mold during the multicolor molding process, and molds a single part that combines resins of different colors. This allows for both complex color coding and ease of assembly!

phrases.en: Under the supervision of mechanical designer Kanetake Ebikawa, we focused on the most distinctive solar furnace "GN Drive". Thorough investigation of the mechanism by which "GN particles" are transmitted from the driving force "GN Drive" to the whole body. In addition to embodying the design arrangement and internal frame structure derived from this, even the light emission effect when "GN particles" are accumulated and compressed is reproduced with a new approach, such as a newly designed LED unit, newly adopted light guide material, and gimmick.

phrases.ja: －－－－－－－－－－－－－強 化 型 ダ ブ ル ゼ ー タ ガ ン ダ ム 来 る ―ダ ブ ル ゼ ー タ ガ ン ダ ム 強 化 型 プ ラ ン 、発 動－－－－－－－－－－－－－　ＭＧ “Ｖｅｒ．Ｋａ”シリーズで、ダブルゼータガンダム強化型を再現！　大型化した肩部・バックパック等を新規造形で再現。アニメ登場時のカラーリングをイメージした機体色を採用。　● 強化型に進化を遂げた、ダブルゼータガンダム“Ｖｅｒ．Ｋａ”　　ジェネレーターの高出力化や、推力の増強が図られた、ダブルゼータガンダムからの改修部分を新規造形で再現。　・ ＳＨＯＵＬＤＥＲ / ＡＲＭ　　ダブルゼータガンダムと比較して大型化した、肩アーマー、腕部シールドを新規造形で再現。　　肩アーマーには、天面にスラスターを増設。・　ＷＡＩＳＴ　　一部形状が変更になった、腹部装甲、フロントスカート、新たに追加されたリアスカートは新規パーツで再現。・ ＢＥＡＭ ＳＡＢＥＲ　　大型化した持ち手部分は新規パーツを使用。　・ ＬＥＧ　　スラスターが増設されたふくらはぎ部分や、足先・かかと部分の差異を新規造形で再現。　・ ＢＡＣＫ ＰＡＣＫ　　水平尾翼、ミサイルポッド、ノズル等、各所が大型化したバックパックを徹底再現。　　装弾数が拡充されたミサイル・ポッド、新たに設置された２基の大型バーニア等、細部まで徹底再現。　　● アニメ登場時のカラーをイメージした成形色　　アニメ映像内でのカラーリングをイメージした、やや緑がかった機体色を基調とした成形色を採用。　●　アニメカラーイメージのダブルゼータガンダムも選択式で再現可能　● 最新フォーマットにより、“可動”と”プロポーション”を高水準で両立　　肩部の関節は広い可動域を確保しているほか、膝部関節は、複雑な変形に加えて深い「曲げ」も再現可能。　　腰部には、これまでになかった3軸構造が採用され、「腰の捻り」と「前屈」が可能。　　● “Ｖｅｒ.Ｋａ”マーキング　　強化型ダブルゼータガンダムを、“ ＭＧ Ver.Ka ”で楽しむ、新規デザインのマーキングが水転写デカールで付属。　　　●　パッケージ　　カトキハジメ氏が手掛ける新規描き下ろしイラストを採用した、フルカラーパッケージ。　　付属武装 ： ダブル・ビーム・ライフル ／ ビーム・サーベル　－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－１／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル対象年齢：１５才以上製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません。－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－　　　　　　※写真の完成品は開発途中の試作品です。また、塗装してあります。実際の商品とは多少異なる場合がございます。　※強化型ダブルゼータガンダムは変形できません。　（備考）　・ この商品は、プラモデルお取り扱い店舗店頭ではお買い求めいただけません。　・ この商品は、弊社主催イベントや他の企画、海外などで販売をさせていただく場合がございます。　・ この商品は‘プレミアムバンダイ’での販売準備数に限りがございます。品切れの際はご了承ください。　・ この商品は、生産準備数の都合により、お一人様につきご購入いただける数量を限らせていただいております。　　 ご了承ください。　・ この商品は、お申込状況、生産の都合により、発送日が変更となる場合がございます。予めご了承ください。　・ 商品画像は開発途中のものであり、実際の商品とは異なる場合がございます。　・ 商品仕様は2017年9月現在の予定です。変更の場合もございますがご了承ください。
phrases.en: －－－－－－－－－－－－－強 化 型 ダ ブ ル ゼ ー タ ガ ン ダ ム 来 る ―ダ ブ ル ゼ ー タ ガ ン ダ ム 強 化 型 プ ラ ン 、発 動－－－－－－－－－－－－－ ＭＧ “Ｖｅｒ．Ｋａ”シリーズで、ダブルゼータGundam強化型を再現！ The enlarged shoulders, backpack, etc. are reproduced with new modeling. The aircraft color is based on the coloring when it appeared in the anime. ●Double Zeta Gundam “Ver.Ka” has evolved into a strengthened version The modified parts of the Double Zeta Gundam, which have a higher output generator and increased thrust, are reproduced with new modeling. ・ SHOULDER / ARM The shoulder armor and arm seals, which are larger than the Double Zeta Gundam, are reproduced with new modeling. The shoulder armor has additional thrusters on the top.・WAIST The abdominal armor, front skirt, and newly added rear skirt, whose shapes have been partially changed, are reproduced with new parts.・BEAM SABER The enlarged handle uses new parts. - The calf part where the LEG thruster was added, and the differences in the toe and heel parts are reproduced with new modeling. ・ BACK PACK The backpack has been thoroughly reproduced with larger parts such as the horizontal stabilizer, missile pod, and nozzle. Missile pods with increased number of bullets, two newly installed large verniers, etc. are thoroughly reproduced in detail. ● Molding color based on the color when it appeared in the anime The molding color is based on the slightly greenish body color, which is based on the coloring in the anime video. ● Anime color image of Double Zeta Gundam can also be selectively reproduced ● The latest format achieves both "movability" and "proportion" at a high level The shoulder joints have a wide range of motion, and the knee joints can reproduce deep "bending" in addition to complex deformations. The lower back has a three-axis structure that has never been seen before, allowing for "twisting" and "forward bending". ● “Ver.Ka” Marking Enjoy the enhanced Double Zeta Gundam in “MG Ver.Ka” with newly designed markings included as water slide decals. ●Package A full-color package featuring new illustrations by Hajime Katoki. 付属武装 ： ダブル・ビーム・ライフル ／ ビーム・サーベル －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－１／１００ScaleAssembly式プラModel対象齢：１５才以上製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ・Assemblyに接着剤は使用しません。 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ *The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. The boomerang on the shoulder armor is removable and can be attached to both hands.

Plated parts and clear parts are used for the head antenna, chest mechanic, etc. The handle of the beam saber can be mounted on the rear armor. This kit comes with two original weapons and strike shooters.

phrases.en: Introducing an expansion unit that can reproduce the Unicorn Gundam Unit 2 Banshee driven by Marida Cruz in real grade! *This product does not include the MS body. Can reproduce the wide open state. - The psycho frame part is molded in clear yellow. ● Comes with a newly designed realistic decal that is exposed as it transforms into Destroy mode! Realistic decals compatible with Armed Armor VN/BS make it possible to express the metal texture unique to RG. ● The same scale figure of Marida Cruz is included (standing). A newly sculpted 1/144 Scale figure of Marida Cruz riding the Banshee is included. Set contents: Armed Armor VN / Armed Armor BS / Realistic decals / Scale figure An 'armed' unit that can be attached to "Banshee Norn" (sold separately) to recreate the Banshee equipped with Armed Armor VN/BS that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam UC". *The MS body is not included with this product. * To reproduce the photos posted on this page, you will need the pre-assembly product "RG 1/144 Unicorn Gundam Unit 2 Banshee Norn" (sold separately) and this product. The tail binder reproduces the vernier part in detail. Can be connected to the waist. The left and right sides of the backpack can be moved independently, and the beam saber rack also opens and closes as set. Weapons include a beam rifle, two beam sabers, a folding bazooka, and a folding seal. Seal can be folded in half as in the setting.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダム W」に新主人公機として登場したウイングガンダムゼロが1/144スケールモデルで登場です。首、手首、股関節及びウイングバーニア基部にボールジョイントを使用し、また胸部と腹部を別パーツ化し、フレキシブルな可動を再現しています。肩アーマーのサイド部、及び腰アーマーのフロント部とサイド部も可動します。左右の着脱が可能なツインバスターライフルは、ネオバード形態時にはシールドにマウントできます。他にビームサーベル1本が付いています。ふくらはぎのハッチが開閉可能です。nウイングバーニア部の差し替えにより、ネオバード形態への変形が可能です。学生服姿のヒイロのフィギュアが付いています。
phrases.en: Wing Gundam Zero, which appeared as the new protagonist machine in "Mobile Suit Gundam W", is now available as a 1/144 Scale Model. Ball joints are used for the neck, wrists, hip joints, and base of the wing vernier, and the chest and abdomen are separate parts to reproduce flexible movement. The side parts of the shoulder armor and the front and side parts of the waist armor are also movable. The twin buster rifle, which can be attached and detached on the left and right sides, can be mounted on Seal when in neobird form. Also includes one beam saber. Calf hatch can be opened and closed. By replacing the n-wing vernier part, it can be transformed into Neobird form. Comes with a figure of Heero in a school uniform.

As a fighting action part, it comes with a torso with the shoulder axis tilted forward and the waist bent forward in order to reproduce the state of swinging Heat Shotel down. Heat Shotel can be used as a backpack by replacing the handle. In addition, it is possible to reproduce the cross crusher by attaching it to a special seal that did not appear in the movie.

phrases.ja: 「新機動戦記ガンダムW エンドレスワルツ」に登場するトールギスIIIを1/144スケールモデル、全身クリアーパーツとメッキパーツの特別バージョンで再現しました。胴体パーツは胸部と腹部をボールジョイントで接続するため、腰のひねりを再現できます。肩アーマー部のブースターは劇中通りの展開が可能で、左右のマウントラッチにはメガキャノンとシールドを着脱できます。メガキャノンは展開状態のみですが、発射ポーズを再現できます。シールド下部にマウントするヒートロッドは長短2種が付いており、どちらかを選択して取り付けられ、シールド基部でスイングが可能です。トールギス、トールギスII用のパーツも付いていますので、どれか一つを選んで組み立てる事が出来ます。ドーバーガン、シールドはそれぞれ肩アーマー部にマウントでき、また手に持たせる事も可能です。
phrases.en: The Tallgeese III that appears in "Mobile Suit GundamW: Endless Waltz" is reproduced with a 1/144 Scale Model, a special version with full body clear parts and plated parts. The torso parts connect the chest and abdomen with a ball joint, allowing you to recreate the twist of the waist. The booster on the shoulder armor can be deployed as shown in the movie, and the mega cannon and Seal can be attached and detached from the left and right mount latches. Mega Cannon can reproduce the firing pose only when it is in the expanded state. The heat rod that mounts at the bottom of the seal comes in two types, long and short, and can be installed by selecting one, and can be swung at the base of the seal. It also comes with parts for Tallgeese and Tallgeese II, so you can choose one and assemble it. The Dover gun and Seal can be mounted on the shoulder armor, and can also be held in the hand.
